schemes.name: Mukhya Mantri Swavalamban Yojana (MMSY)
schemes.status: Active - bank or continuous route
schemes.label: MSME / self-employment
schemes.bestFor: New manufacturing or service unit by eligible Himachali youth
schemes.eligible: Bonafide Himachali, generally age 18–45; women up to 50; activity must be on the notified positive list
schemes.support: Capital subsidy + interest subsidy + fee/land concessions
schemes.benefit: Investment subsidy: 25% general, 30% SC/ST, 35% women/divyang; eligible plant/machinery/equipment base up to ₹60 lakh. Interest subsidy 5% for 3 years on loan up to ₹60 lakh; project cost up to ₹1 crore.
schemes.margin: Balance project cost; lender margin and appraisal apply
schemes.access: Apply through the MMSY portal/District Industries Centre (DIC), then the financing bank.
schemes.caution: Confirm activity, age and current district target before incurring expenditure.

schemes.name: State Mission on Food Processing – technology upgradation/new unit
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Food processing
schemes.bestFor: New or modernising food-processing unit
schemes.eligible: Eligible private food-processing enterprise/entity under State Mission guidelines
schemes.benefit: 33.33% of eligible project cost, maximum ₹75 lakh.
schemes.margin: At least the non-grant portion; bank/project appraisal may apply
schemes.access: Submit DPR through Industries Department/DIC under the current State Mission window.
schemes.caution: Do not combine with another grant on the same cost component.

schemes.name: State Mission on Food Processing – cold chain/value addition
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Food processing / cold chain
schemes.bestFor: Integrated cold chain and value-addition infrastructure for non-horticulture produce
schemes.eligible: Eligible private/cooperative/producer entities under current State Mission guidelines
schemes.benefit: 50% of eligible cost, maximum ₹5 crore.
schemes.access: Apply to Industries Department with DPR and approvals.
schemes.caution: Horticulture cold-chain components may instead fall under MIDH/NHB; avoid duplicate aid.

schemes.name: State Mission on Food Processing – rural primary processing/collection centre
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agri / food infrastructure
schemes.bestFor: Rural primary processing and collection infrastructure
schemes.eligible: Eligible rural enterprise/producer/cooperative entity
schemes.benefit: 75% of eligible cost, maximum ₹2.5 crore.
schemes.access: Apply under the State Mission through DIC/Industries Department.
schemes.caution: Location and project-component eligibility must be confirmed in the live call.

schemes.name: State Mission on Food Processing – meat-shop modernisation
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Meat retail / food safety
schemes.bestFor: Modernisation of eligible meat shops
schemes.eligible: Licensed/eligible meat-shop operator
schemes.benefit: 75% of eligible cost, maximum ₹5 lakh.
schemes.access: Apply through DIC with local-body and food-safety documents.
schemes.caution: Subject to municipal, pollution and food-safety approvals.

schemes.name: State Mission on Food Processing – reefer vehicle
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Food logistics
schemes.bestFor: Refrigerated transport for eligible food products
schemes.eligible: Eligible enterprise/producer/cooperative entity
schemes.benefit: 50% of eligible cost, maximum ₹50 lakh.
schemes.access: Apply through DIC/Industries Department before purchase.
schemes.caution: Vehicle specifications and linkage to eligible processing activity are checked.

schemes.name: Startup Himachal – sustenance allowance
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Startup
schemes.bestFor: Recognised innovative startup incubated in the State
schemes.eligible: Eligible Startup Himachal-recognised startup, subject to committee/incubator approval
schemes.benefit: ₹25,000 per month for up to 1 year.
schemes.access: Obtain Startup Himachal recognition and apply through an approved incubator/Startup portal.
schemes.caution: Recognition alone does not create an automatic entitlement; approval is milestone-based.

schemes.name: Startup Himachal – HIMSUP seed fund
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Startup / innovation
schemes.bestFor: Early-stage product, prototype, market entry or scaling
schemes.eligible: Eligible recognised startup selected under HIMSUP
schemes.benefit: Up to ₹50 lakh, subject to evaluation, milestones and approved instrument/terms.
schemes.access: Apply through Startup Himachal/incubator when the seed-fund window is open.
schemes.caution: Competitive selection; not a universal reimbursement.

schemes.name: Startup Himachal – DPR preparation reimbursement
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Startup / innovation
schemes.bestFor: Preparation of a bankable project report
schemes.eligible: Eligible recognised startup
schemes.benefit: 75% of eligible DPR cost, maximum ₹1 lakh.
schemes.access: Seek prior/required approvals and submit invoices through Startup Himachal.
schemes.caution: Use empanelled/acceptable consultants and preserve proof of payment.

schemes.name: Startup Himachal – micro-enterprise interest subvention
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Startup / MSME
schemes.bestFor: Recognised micro startup using term finance
schemes.eligible: Recognised startup meeting micro-investment/employment conditions
schemes.benefit: 5% interest subvention for 3 years on loan up to ₹25 lakh.
schemes.access: Apply through Startup Himachal after loan sanction and eligible repayment.
schemes.caution: Regular repayment and continuing eligibility are normally required.

schemes.name: Startup Himachal – patent reimbursement
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Startup / innovation
schemes.bestFor: Indian or foreign patent filing by recognised startup
schemes.eligible: Eligible recognised startup
schemes.benefit: Up to ₹2 lakh for an Indian patent and up to ₹10 lakh for a foreign patent, subject to eligible actual cost.
schemes.access: Apply with filing/grant documents and paid invoices through Startup Himachal.
schemes.caution: Check whether filing, prosecution and grant-stage costs are covered in the current procedure.

schemes.name: Mukhya Mantri Krishi Samvardhan Yojana (MKSY/MMKSY)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agriculture
schemes.bestFor: Farm inputs, cluster production, seed multiplication and agriculture-support components
schemes.eligible: Farmers/farmer groups; component-specific eligibility
schemes.benefit: Common notified input rates include 50% on seed of cereals/pulses/oilseeds/fodder and 25% on potato/ginger/turmeric; other components vary annually.
schemes.access: Apply through local Agriculture Extension Officer/block office under the notified component.
schemes.caution: MKSY is an umbrella; use the current component circular, not a single blanket percentage.

schemes.name: Mukhya Mantri Khet Sanrakshan Yojana (MMKSY) – crop-protection fencing
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agriculture / crop protection
schemes.bestFor: Solar, interlink, barbed-wire or composite fencing
schemes.eligible: Eligible farmers/groups under departmental specification and approved cluster/individual case
schemes.benefit: Assistance is tiered by fencing type on the approved cost norm: solar fencing 80% for an individual and 85% for a group; composite fencing 70%; barbed wire / chain-link fencing 50%.
schemes.margin: 15%-50% of approved cost depending on fencing type, plus any non-admissible cost
schemes.access: Apply to Agriculture Department before ordering/installation.
schemes.caution: Sanction, design, vendor/specification and physical verification precede subsidy.

schemes.name: Rajya Krishi Yantrikaran Yojana
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Farm mechanisation
schemes.bestFor: Purchase of notified farm machinery/equipment
schemes.eligible: Eligible farmers/groups/custom-hiring entities under annual norms
schemes.benefit: Generally 40%–50% on notified equipment and benchmark cost; exact rate varies by beneficiary and machine.
schemes.access: Apply through Agriculture Department/DBT workflow before purchase.
schemes.caution: Do not confuse with the central SMAM component; check the current machine-wise cost norm.

schemes.name: Jal Se Krishi Ko Bal
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agriculture / irrigation
schemes.bestFor: Community water harvesting such as check dams and ponds
schemes.eligible: Farmer groups/community beneficiaries through approved works
schemes.benefit: Government bears 100% of approved community work cost under departmental norms.
schemes.margin: Normally nil for approved public work
schemes.access: Propose through Agriculture Department/block office; work is department-sanctioned.
schemes.caution: This is not a cash grant to an individual farmer.

schemes.name: Flow Irrigation Scheme
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agriculture / irrigation
schemes.bestFor: Kuhl/community flow irrigation and eligible individual wells
schemes.eligible: Farmer groups for community works; eligible individuals for bore/shallow wells
schemes.benefit: 100% for approved community kuhl work; 50% subsidy for eligible individual bore/shallow wells.
schemes.margin: 50% for individual well; component-specific for other work
schemes.access: Apply through Agriculture Department before construction.
schemes.caution: Water availability, technical feasibility and cost norms apply.

schemes.name: Rajiv Gandhi Prakritik Kheti Khushhal Kisan Yojana
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Natural farming
schemes.bestFor: Transition to certified/verified natural farming and on-farm inputs
schemes.eligible: Participating farmers registered with the Natural Farming programme
schemes.benefit: Illustrative support: drums ₹750 each (max 3), cow-urine pit up to ₹8,000, indigenous cow 50% up to ₹25,000 plus transport up to ₹5,000; notified procurement support for natural produce.
schemes.access: Register through Agriculture Department/ATMA natural-farming staff.
schemes.caution: Rates/procurement crops are notification-driven; verify the current season.

schemes.name: Him Unnati / Him Krishi cluster programme
schemes.status: Active - cluster or project area
schemes.label: Agriculture / value chain
schemes.bestFor: Cluster production, aggregation, services and market linkage
schemes.eligible: Farmers/FPOs in selected clusters
schemes.benefit: Need-based approved support through about 2,600 clusters; no single universal cash percentage.
schemes.access: Contact Agriculture Department to confirm whether the village/commodity cluster is selected.
schemes.caution: Enabling programme; the sanctioned cluster DPR controls individual benefits.

schemes.name: HP Crop Diversification Promotion Project (JICA Phase II)
schemes.status: Active - cluster or project area
schemes.label: Agriculture / irrigation / value chain
schemes.bestFor: Irrigation, farm access, fencing, diversification and value-chain support in project areas
schemes.eligible: Farmers/groups in selected project areas
schemes.benefit: Support is delivered through approved subprojects and farmer groups; no single beneficiary-wide rate.
schemes.access: Contact the project/Agriculture Department for selected locations and components.
schemes.caution: Not an open statewide reimbursement scheme.

schemes.name: Kisan Evam Khetihar Mazdoor Jeevan Suraksha Yojana
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Farm safety / social protection
schemes.bestFor: Accident involving farm machinery/operations
schemes.eligible: Eligible farmer or agricultural labourer/family under scheme conditions
schemes.benefit: ₹10,000–₹40,000 for specified injuries; ₹1 lakh for severe disability and ₹3 lakh for death, subject to rules.
schemes.access: Submit claim promptly through Agriculture Department/revenue/authorised channel with incident evidence.
schemes.caution: This is accident compensation, not business capital assistance.

schemes.name: Scheme to Support Technology Transfer
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agriculture / capacity building
schemes.bestFor: Exposure visits, training and transfer of improved agricultural technology
schemes.eligible: Selected farmers/groups/officially sponsored participants
schemes.benefit: Programme-funded training/exposure; no standard direct cash ceiling.
schemes.access: Contact Agriculture Department/ATMA for scheduled programmes.
schemes.caution: Enabling support; participation depends on programme calendar.

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM / Saur Sinchai implementation in HP
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Solar irrigation / renewable energy
schemes.bestFor: Standalone solar agriculture pumps and notified solarisation components
schemes.eligible: Eligible farmers/groups under current HP target and technical conditions
schemes.benefit: 85% assistance for small and marginal farmers and 80% for medium and large farmers on approved solar water-lifting/pumping systems, individual or community.
schemes.access: Apply through the HP AgriDBT portal (agridbt.hp.gov.in) or the dedicated PM-KUSUM portal (pmkusumagri.hp.gov.in) via the Block/District Agriculture Office.
schemes.caution: Original CSV's separate 60%/80% rows were not a reliable representation of HP's current assistance.

schemes.name: Horticulture Development Scheme (HDS)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Horticulture
schemes.bestFor: Sprayers, power tillers and notified orchard machinery
schemes.eligible: Eligible horticulturists under machine-wise norms
schemes.benefit: Subsidy on notified horticulture machinery at annual benchmark rates; percentage/ceiling varies by item and beneficiary.
schemes.access: Apply through District Horticulture Office before purchase.
schemes.caution: Use the current machine-wise rate circular.

schemes.name: Installation of Anti-Hail Nets
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Horticulture / orchard protection
schemes.bestFor: Anti-hail net system for eligible orchards
schemes.eligible: Eligible orchardists meeting area and specification norms
schemes.benefit: Assistance at the currently notified percentage and benchmark cost; annual ceiling/target applies.
schemes.access: Apply through Horticulture Department before installation.
schemes.caution: MIDH and State components can overlap; claim only one aid stream per cost item.

schemes.name: Himachal Pushp Kranti Yojana
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Floriculture / protected cultivation
schemes.bestFor: Commercial flowers and protected structures
schemes.eligible: Eligible growers/entrepreneurs under notified floriculture component
schemes.benefit: Component-wise assistance for approved floriculture/protected-cultivation investments; current DPR and cost norms control the amount.
schemes.access: Apply through District Horticulture Office.
schemes.caution: Obtain technical sanction before constructing a protected structure.

schemes.name: Mukhya Mantri Kiwi Protsahan Yojana
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Horticulture
schemes.bestFor: New kiwi plantation/support systems
schemes.eligible: Eligible growers in technically suitable areas
schemes.benefit: Assistance follows annual plant, area and support-system cost norms; no single reliable statewide ceiling was published in the source reviewed.
schemes.access: Apply through Horticulture Department after site suitability assessment.
schemes.caution: Use current district allocation and technical package.

schemes.name: MIDH implementation in Himachal Pradesh
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Horticulture / post-harvest
schemes.bestFor: Orchards, nurseries, protected cultivation, mushrooms, mechanisation and post-harvest components
schemes.eligible: Farmers, entrepreneurs, FPOs/cooperatives; component-specific
schemes.benefit: In Himalayan states many private-sector components receive 50% of benchmark cost; some components range 40%–75%. Caps are component-specific.
schemes.access: Apply through Horticulture Department under the approved Annual Action Plan.
schemes.caution: Use the 2025 MIDH cost norm and current HP action plan; do not use a generic percentage for every component.

schemes.name: PMKSY – Per Drop More Crop (micro-irrigation)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agriculture / horticulture irrigation
schemes.bestFor: Drip and sprinkler systems
schemes.eligible: Eligible farmers; land and water-source conditions apply
schemes.benefit: 55% of benchmark cost for small/marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers under national norms; HP annual implementation may add/adjust approved support.
schemes.access: Apply through Agriculture/Horticulture Department before installation.
schemes.caution: Confirm whether the farm component is routed through Agriculture or Horticulture in the district.

schemes.name: Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme – horticulture crops
schemes.family: Insurance risk compensation and income support
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Horticulture insurance
schemes.bestFor: Notified fruit/horticulture crops against weather triggers
schemes.eligible: Growers of notified crop in notified area during enrolment window
schemes.benefit: Farmer pays the notified subsidised premium; claim is trigger-based using weather data, not individual loss assessment.
schemes.access: Enrol through notified insurer/bank/CSC within seasonal cut-off.
schemes.caution: Crop, area, insurer, premium and dates change each season.

schemes.name: Market Intervention Scheme for apple/mango/citrus
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Horticulture marketing
schemes.bestFor: Disposal of eligible grade/quality produce through notified procurement centres
schemes.eligible: Registered/eligible growers meeting current notification
schemes.benefit: Market Intervention Scheme 2026-27 (approved July 2026): C-grade apple ₹12/kg, procurement 1 August-31 October 2026, up to 1.50 lakh MT; processing-grade mango ₹12/kg, 15 July-31 August 2026; citrus ₹12/kg for kinnow, malta and sangtra and ₹10/kg for galgal, 21 November 2026-15 February 2027. Procurement by HPMC, with HIMFED assisting on apple.
schemes.access: Use notified HPMC/HIMFED/agency collection centres during the season.
schemes.caution: Seasonal and grade-specific; price and quantity limits must be rechecked each crop year.

schemes.name: Him Kukkut Palan Yojana
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Poultry
schemes.bestFor: Commercial broiler unit package
schemes.eligible: Eligible Himachali poultry entrepreneur under department norms
schemes.benefit: Package of 3,000 broiler chicks with feed/equipment; 60% subsidy on eligible capital and recurring components.
schemes.access: Apply through local Veterinary/Animal Husbandry office before unit setup.
schemes.caution: Biosecurity, shed, training and departmental inspection conditions apply.

schemes.name: Krishak Bakri Palan Yojana
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Goat farming
schemes.bestFor: Small goat-rearing units
schemes.eligible: Eligible farmers under 3-, 5- or 11-goat unit pattern
schemes.benefit: 60% subsidy on the approved unit package.
schemes.access: Apply through Veterinary Officer/Animal Husbandry Department.
schemes.caution: Breed, unit composition, insurance and beneficiary-priority rules apply.

schemes.name: Breeding ram distribution subsidy
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Sheep farming
schemes.bestFor: Breed improvement for flocks
schemes.eligible: Eligible breeder owning the prescribed flock (survey indicates 20 sheep)
schemes.benefit: 60% subsidy on approved breeding ram cost.
schemes.access: Apply through Veterinary/Sheep Development office.
schemes.caution: Subject to breed availability and flock verification.

schemes.name: BPL pregnant cattle ration subsidy
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Dairy / livestock
schemes.bestFor: Feed support in final stage of pregnancy
schemes.eligible: Eligible BPL livestock owner with verified pregnant cattle
schemes.benefit: 50% subsidy on prescribed ration for last 3 months of pregnancy; survey refers to 3 kg/day.
schemes.access: Register/verify through local Veterinary Institution.
schemes.caution: Not a commercial-unit capital subsidy.

schemes.name: Uttam Pashu Puraskar Yojana
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Dairy / livestock
schemes.bestFor: Recognition of high-yielding cow/buffalo
schemes.eligible: Owner of animal meeting notified milk-yield benchmark
schemes.benefit: ₹1,000 per qualifying cow/buffalo; survey cites 15 litres/day benchmark.
schemes.access: Participate through local Veterinary Institution/department verification.
schemes.caution: Award criteria and verification period apply.

schemes.name: Backyard Poultry Programme
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Poultry / livelihood
schemes.bestFor: Small backyard poultry flock
schemes.eligible: Eligible rural household/farmer
schemes.benefit: 3-week-old chicks supplied in lots generally ranging from 10 to 100 at departmental cost price.
schemes.access: Apply through local Veterinary Institution subject to chick availability.
schemes.caution: This is subsidised/supported supply, not a cash grant.

schemes.name: Fisheries insurance under PMMSY/HP implementation
schemes.family: Insurance risk compensation and income support
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Fisheries / social protection
schemes.bestFor: Accidental death/disability cover for registered fishers
schemes.eligible: Registered eligible fisher under current group insurance
schemes.benefit: Group Accident Insurance Scheme under PMMSY: ₹5 lakh for death or permanent total disability, ₹2.5 lakh for permanent partial disability and ₹25,000 towards accidental hospitalisation, for fishers aged 18-70; premium is borne under the scheme.
schemes.margin: Premium share as notified, often subsidised
schemes.access: Register with Fisheries Department/cooperative during enrolment.
schemes.caution: Confirm insurer, cover and nominee details for the current policy year.

schemes.name: HP Fisheries Risk Fund
schemes.family: Insurance risk compensation and income support
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Fisheries
schemes.bestFor: Loss/damage to eligible craft and gear
schemes.eligible: Registered eligible fisher meeting incident rules
schemes.benefit: Generally 50% assistance for admissible loss of craft/gear under State rules.
schemes.access: Report incident promptly to Fisheries Department with evidence.
schemes.caution: Claim ceilings and eligible causes should be confirmed in the current order.

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
schemes.status: Active - bank or continuous route
schemes.label: MSME / self-employment
schemes.bestFor: New micro manufacturing or service enterprise
schemes.eligible: Individual above 18 and eligible institutions; only new project; education rule for larger projects
schemes.benefit: Project ceiling: ₹50 lakh manufacturing, ₹20 lakh service. General: 10% own contribution and 15% urban/25% rural subsidy. Special category: 5% contribution and 25% urban/35% rural subsidy.
schemes.access: Apply only on PMEGP e-portal; scrutiny by KVIC/KVIB/DIC and bank.
schemes.caution: Hill-area classification may support special-category rates; portal and bank decide final category.

schemes.name: PMEGP 2nd Loan for Upgradation
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Active - bank or continuous route
schemes.label: MSME expansion
schemes.bestFor: Expansion of a successful existing PMEGP/REGP/MUDRA unit
schemes.eligible: Existing unit with first loan repaid and prescribed profitable track record
schemes.benefit: Margin-money subsidy of 15% of project cost, raised to 20% for NER and Hill States (Himachal Pradesh qualifies). Manufacturing: project up to ₹1 crore, maximum subsidy ₹15 lakh (₹20 lakh in hill/NER). Service or business: project up to ₹25 lakh, maximum subsidy ₹3.75 lakh (₹5 lakh in hill/NER). Own contribution 10%.
schemes.access: Apply through PMEGP portal/implementing agency and lender.
schemes.caution: Eligibility includes performance and repayment conditions; not a general second loan for every MUDRA borrower.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Micro enterprise credit
schemes.bestFor: Non-corporate, non-farm micro business and permitted allied activities
schemes.eligible: Eligible micro entrepreneur with viable activity
schemes.benefit: Shishu up to ₹50,000; Kishore above ₹50,000–₹5 lakh; Tarun above ₹5–₹10 lakh; Tarun Plus above ₹10–₹20 lakh only for borrowers who successfully repaid a Tarun loan.
schemes.access: Apply through bank, RRB, small finance bank, MFI/NBFC or JanSamarth where offered.
schemes.caution: No direct subsidy; interest is lender-determined. Guarantee is under the MUDRA/CGFMU framework, not ordinary CGTMSE.

schemes.name: CGTMSE credit guarantee
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: MSME credit guarantee
schemes.bestFor: Collateral/third-party-guarantee constraint on MSE borrowing
schemes.eligible: Eligible new/existing micro or small enterprise through a member lender
schemes.benefit: Guarantee cover on eligible credit up to ₹10 crore per borrower, effective for guarantees approved on or after 1 April 2025 (raised from ₹5 crore). Extent of guarantee generally 75%-85% depending on borrower and facility category, subject to current rules and the annual guarantee fee.
schemes.margin: Borrower pays lender margin/fees unless another scheme reimburses
schemes.access: Ask the lender to cover the eligible facility under CGTMSE; borrower does not apply directly to the Trust.
schemes.caution: A guarantee reduces lender loss, not the borrower's repayment obligation; the original ₹2 crore ceiling was obsolete.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Artisan / traditional trades
schemes.bestFor: Recognition, skilling, tools, credit and market support for 18 notified trades
schemes.eligible: Eligible traditional artisan/craftsperson, generally one member per family, subject to exclusions
schemes.benefit: Toolkit incentive up to ₹15,000 via e-RUPI voucher; training stipend ₹500/day (basic 5-7 days, advanced 15 days); collateral-free enterprise loans of up to ₹1 lakh (18-month repayment) then up to ₹2 lakh (30-month repayment), beneficiary interest 5% with Government interest subvention capped at 8 percentage points; digital incentive ₹1 per transaction up to 100 transactions a month; marketing support through a ₹250 crore corpus. Scheme period FY2023-24 to FY2027-28.
schemes.margin: No margin normally specified for credit tranche; repayment required
schemes.access: Register through CSC/PM Vishwakarma portal; verification by local bodies and committee.
schemes.caution: Original CSV incorrectly marked no interest subvention.

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi (restructured)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Street-vending micro business
schemes.bestFor: Working capital for eligible urban street vendor
schemes.eligible: Survey-identified/LoR-eligible street vendor
schemes.support: Working-capital loan + interest subsidy + digital incentive
schemes.benefit: Restructured scheme (Cabinet approval August 2025): progressive loans of ₹15,000, then ₹25,000, then ₹50,000; a UPI-linked RuPay credit card for vendors who repay the second loan on time; digital-transaction cashback up to ₹1,600 a year; lending period extended to 31 March 2030 and coverage being extended beyond statutory towns to census towns and peri-urban areas.
schemes.access: Apply through urban local body/portal and participating lender.
schemes.caution: Eligibility is tied to vending survey/certificate or Letter of Recommendation.

schemes.name: Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (SCLCSS)
schemes.status: Active - bank or continuous route
schemes.label: SC/ST-owned MSE
schemes.bestFor: New machinery/equipment or technology upgrade
schemes.eligible: SC/ST-owned micro/small manufacturing or service enterprise; trading excluded
schemes.benefit: 25% of eligible term-loan/machinery value, subsidy ceiling ₹25 lakh (institutional finance up to ₹1 crore for calculation).
schemes.access: Apply through the term-lending institution, which uploads the claim.
schemes.caution: This is current; the general legacy CLCSS is not the same scheme.

schemes.name: Micro and Small Enterprises Cluster Development Programme (MSE-CDP)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: MSME cluster infrastructure
schemes.bestFor: Common Facility Centre (CFC) or industrial-estate infrastructure
schemes.eligible: Eligible cluster/SPV and State/implementing agency
schemes.benefit: Common Facility Centre: project cost ₹5-10 crore, GoI grant 70% (80% for NER, Hill States including Himachal Pradesh, islands and aspirational districts); project cost above ₹10 crore and up to ₹30 crore, GoI grant 60% (70% for the same special categories). Infrastructure Development: new infrastructure ₹5-15 crore, GoI 60% (70% special category); upgradation ₹5-10 crore, GoI 50% (60% special category).
schemes.access: Prepare cluster diagnostic/DPR through State/cluster SPV and submit on the scheme system.
schemes.caution: Not an individual-firm subsidy.

schemes.name: SFURTI – Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries
schemes.status: Active - cluster or project area
schemes.label: Traditional industry cluster
schemes.bestFor: Common facilities, skills, design and market support for artisan clusters
schemes.eligible: Eligible NGO/institution/SPV/implementing agency and artisans
schemes.benefit: Regular cluster (100-500 artisans; minimum 50 in hilly areas) up to ₹2.5 crore; major cluster above 500 artisans up to ₹5 crore. Hard intervention: GoI 90% generally, 95% for NER, J&K and hilly states with 5% SPV contribution in cash. Soft intervention: 100% GoI funded, capped at 10% of the hard-intervention amount or ₹25 lakh, whichever is less.
schemes.margin: Typically 5% SPV hard-intervention share in hill area
schemes.access: Route cluster proposal through designated nodal/technical agency.
schemes.caution: Cluster-level support, not direct reimbursement to each artisan.

schemes.name: MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification
schemes.family: Quality testing certification IP and compliance
schemes.status: Active - bank or continuous route
schemes.label: MSME quality / green
schemes.bestFor: ZED assessment, certification, testing and handholding
schemes.eligible: Udyam-registered MSME
schemes.benefit: Certification-cost subsidy 80% for micro, 60% for small and 50% for medium enterprises, plus an extra 10% for women/SC/ST-owned units and for units in NER, Himalayan states (Himachal Pradesh qualifies), LWE, island territories and aspirational districts, plus a further 5% for units in a SFURTI or MSE-CDP cluster. One-time joining reward of ₹10,000 on taking the ZED Pledge.
schemes.access: Register on ZED portal using Udyam details.
schemes.caution: Use current portal package and approved providers; this replaces treating ISO reimbursement as a universal standalone scheme.

schemes.name: MSME Competitive (LEAN)
schemes.status: Active - bank or continuous route
schemes.label: MSME productivity
schemes.bestFor: LEAN assessment and implementation
schemes.eligible: Udyam-registered manufacturing MSME or eligible cluster/group
schemes.benefit: Government bears 90% of implementation consultant cost; indicative programme costs: Basic free, Intermediate ₹1.2 lakh, Advanced ₹2.4 lakh, with additional support for specified categories.
schemes.access: Register on LEAN portal and use approved implementation consultant.
schemes.caution: The benefit is for structured LEAN implementation, not machinery purchase.

schemes.name: MSE GIFT – Green Investment and Financing for Transformation
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Green technology / MSE
schemes.bestFor: Investment in eligible green technology
schemes.eligible: Udyam-registered micro or small enterprise meeting eligible green project norms
schemes.benefit: 2% interest subvention on eligible term loan up to ₹2 crore; 75% risk-sharing/guarantee support, subject to guidelines.
schemes.access: Approach participating lender and follow RAMP/MSE-GIFT process.
schemes.caution: Confirm technology list, lender participation and available allocation before sanction.

schemes.name: MSE SPICE – circular economy investment
schemes.status: Active - bank or continuous route
schemes.label: Circular economy / MSE
schemes.bestFor: Brownfield investment for recycling, resource efficiency and circularity
schemes.eligible: Eligible existing Udyam MSE meeting scheme conditions
schemes.benefit: 25% capital subsidy on eligible plant and machinery, maximum ₹12.5 lakh. The subsidy is computed on project cost up to ₹50 lakh; larger projects remain capped at ₹12.5 lakh. Brownfield projects of existing Udyam-registered MSEs only, in the 11 notified circular-economy sectors.
schemes.access: Apply through RAMP/SPICE portal with DPR and financing details.
schemes.caution: Brownfield/circular-economy eligibility and eligible asset list are decisive.

schemes.name: MSME TEAM initiative – e-commerce/ONDC
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Digital commerce / market access
schemes.bestFor: ONDC onboarding, catalogue, account management, logistics and packaging support
schemes.eligible: Eligible MSE, with focus on women and SC/ST-owned MSEs
schemes.benefit: Support includes onboarding/cataloguing up to ₹2,500 per MSE, account management up to ₹5,000, and notified logistics/packaging support.
schemes.access: Apply through the TEAM/ONDC implementation channel when onboarding is open.
schemes.caution: Benefits are service/cost support, not unrestricted cash.

schemes.name: ADEETIE – Assistance in Deploying Energy Efficient Technologies in Industries
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: MSME energy efficiency
schemes.bestFor: Energy-efficiency retrofit in eligible cluster/sector
schemes.eligible: Udyam manufacturing unit in notified 60 clusters/14 sectors meeting energy-saving and technical conditions
schemes.benefit: Interest subvention: 5% for micro/small and 3% for medium enterprise on eligible project finance; technical support also provided.
schemes.access: Register/seek energy audit through BEE/ADEETIE and approach participating lender.
schemes.caution: Location/sector list and minimum energy saving are mandatory; confirm whether the HP unit lies in an eligible cluster.

schemes.name: Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance (RAMP)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: MSME ecosystem
schemes.bestFor: State reforms, market/finance/technology interventions
schemes.eligible: MSMEs benefit through State and component initiatives rather than a single grant application
schemes.benefit: No universal direct benefit; includes initiatives such as GIFT, SPICE and TEAM and State strategic plans.
schemes.access: Use the specific RAMP component or State implementation call.
schemes.caution: Do not list RAMP as a flat subsidy.

schemes.name: Public Procurement Policy for MSEs
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Government procurement
schemes.bestFor: Access to Central Ministry/CPSE procurement
schemes.eligible: Eligible Udyam-registered MSE and product/service meeting tender conditions
schemes.benefit: Central procuring entities target 25% annual procurement from MSEs, including sub-targets of 4% for SC/ST-owned and 3% for women-owned MSEs; tender benefits/exemptions apply under policy.
schemes.access: Register Udyam and GeM; respond to eligible tenders and use MSME Sambandh/Samadhan mechanisms.
schemes.caution: This is market access, not a cash subsidy; tender quality and technical conditions remain.

schemes.name: National SC-ST Hub (NSSH)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: SC/ST entrepreneurship
schemes.bestFor: Vendor development, capacity building, exhibition and procurement support
schemes.eligible: SC/ST-owned MSE/aspiring entrepreneur under the relevant intervention
schemes.benefit: Intervention-specific reimbursement/support; SCLCSS is a separate capital-subsidy component under the Hub.
schemes.access: Register/engage through NSSH/NSIC and current intervention calls.
schemes.caution: Use the exact intervention guideline; the umbrella itself is not a single loan.

schemes.name: Procurement and Marketing Support (PMS)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: MSME marketing
schemes.bestFor: Trade fairs, packaging, barcode, e-commerce and market development interventions
schemes.eligible: Eligible MSE/industry association/implementing agency by component
schemes.benefit: Component- and event-specific support under the current PMS guidelines; no one universal ceiling.
schemes.access: Apply against live MSME-DI/Ministry event or component notice.
schemes.caution: Check live notice before incurring cost.

schemes.name: International Cooperation Scheme
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: MSME exports / international exposure
schemes.bestFor: International exhibitions, delegations and market cooperation
schemes.eligible: Eligible industry association/organisation; participating MSEs through approved proposal
schemes.benefit: Support is component- and event-specific under approved proposals.
schemes.access: Participate through an approved association/Ministry call.
schemes.caution: Usually routed through eligible organisations, not an open individual reimbursement.

schemes.name: Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme (ESDP)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Entrepreneurship / skills
schemes.bestFor: Entrepreneurship awareness and skill programmes
schemes.eligible: Aspiring/existing entrepreneurs selected for scheduled programme
schemes.benefit: Government-supported training; no standard business capital grant.
schemes.access: Enrol in scheduled MSME-DFO/approved-institution programme.
schemes.caution: Training support only.

schemes.name: ASPIRE – Livelihood Business Incubators / Fund of Funds
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agri / rural enterprise incubation
schemes.bestFor: Incubation infrastructure and investment ecosystem
schemes.eligible: Eligible host institution for LBI; startups indirectly through incubator/fund
schemes.benefit: Support follows LBI/Technology Business Incubator/fund component guidelines; not a standard direct grant to every startup.
schemes.access: Entrepreneurs approach an approved incubator; institutions apply under calls.
schemes.caution: Original list should not describe ASPIRE as ordinary borrower subsidy.

schemes.name: Coir Vikas Yojana
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Coir
schemes.bestFor: Skill, machinery, market and welfare interventions in coir value chain
schemes.eligible: Coir artisan/unit/institution depending on component
schemes.benefit: Component-specific assistance under current Coir Board guidelines.
schemes.access: Contact Coir Board regional office/use the current component portal.
schemes.caution: Applicable only where the proposed activity genuinely falls in the coir value chain.

schemes.name: TReDS invoice discounting
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: MSME working capital
schemes.bestFor: Discounting accepted invoices on eligible buyers
schemes.eligible: MSME supplier and onboarded buyer/financier
schemes.benefit: Competitive invoice discounting without collateral; cost is the accepted discount rate, not a subsidy.
schemes.access: Onboard on an RBI-authorised TReDS platform and upload buyer-accepted invoice.
schemes.caution: Buyer acceptance/onboarding is essential.

schemes.name: Mutual Credit Guarantee Scheme for MSMEs (MCGS-MSME)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: MSME machinery finance
schemes.bestFor: Large machinery/equipment-led investment project
schemes.eligible: Udyam-registered new or existing MSME; machinery/equipment must form at least the prescribed share of project cost
schemes.benefit: Guarantee coverage is 60% of the guaranteed term loan, on credit facilities up to ₹100 crore per project. The cost of equipment and machinery must be at least 75% of project cost. Borrower must hold a valid Udyam registration and not be an NPA; an upfront contribution of 5% of the loan amount is deposited with NCGTC.
schemes.margin: Lender margin, upfront contribution/guarantee fee structure and repayment
schemes.access: Approach an NCGTC-registered member lender; lender applies for cover.
schemes.caution: Not an interest subsidy and not automatic collateral-free sanction; lender credit appraisal applies.

schemes.name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Startup finance
schemes.bestFor: Debt to DPIIT-recognised startup
schemes.eligible: Eligible DPIIT-recognised startup and member institution/AIF under current rules
schemes.benefit: Guarantee support for eligible credit up to ₹20 crore per borrower (raised from ₹10 crore in May 2025). Coverage is 85% of the amount in default for loans up to ₹10 crore and 75% above ₹10 crore. Annual guarantee fee reduced to 1% p.a. for startups in the 27 notified Champion Sectors.
schemes.access: Approach a member institution; guarantee is obtained by the institution.
schemes.caution: Guarantee is for the lender/investor and does not waive repayment.

schemes.name: SIDBI SPEED (rationalised machinery/equipment finance)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: MSME equipment finance
schemes.bestFor: Purchase of machinery/equipment
schemes.eligible: Creditworthy MSME meeting SIDBI product and operating-history requirements
schemes.benefit: Need-based machinery/equipment finance; current pricing, loan size, collateral and contribution are case-specific. Earlier ARISE/SPEED Plus/PRATHAM branch products were merged into rationalised SPEED.
schemes.access: Apply to SIDBI through current branch/digital channel.
schemes.caution: Original ARISE row is no longer a separate current product.

schemes.name: SIDBI PRAYAAS
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Informal micro enterprise
schemes.bestFor: Livelihood/micro-enterprise credit for informal entrepreneurs
schemes.eligible: Eligible informal micro entrepreneur served by a participating partner institution
schemes.benefit: ₹50,000–₹5 lakh through partner institutions; over 85% of beneficiaries reported as women.
schemes.access: Apply through a participating PRAYAAS partner institution, not necessarily directly at a SIDBI branch.
schemes.caution: Availability depends on partner coverage in the applicant's location.

schemes.name: SIDBI digital business loan
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: MSME business finance
schemes.bestFor: Machinery, renovation, outlet, vehicle, stock or eligible business purpose
schemes.eligible: GST- and Udyam-registered business with generally 3+ years operations and product conditions
schemes.benefit: Up to ₹25 lakh; repayment up to 36 months; published starting rate from 10.5% p.a., subject to credit profile.
schemes.access: Apply through SIDBI's digital/business-loan channel.
schemes.caution: This is a commercial loan, not a subsidy; geography and profitability conditions apply.

schemes.name: Micro Credit Card Scheme for Micro Enterprises
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Micro enterprise credit
schemes.bestFor: Short-cycle working capital through a reusable credit line
schemes.eligible: Udyam-registered micro enterprise meeting lender credit criteria
schemes.benefit: Revolving credit up to ₹5 lakh for Udyam-registered micro enterprises, with no collateral, backed by a CGTMSE guarantee. Launched 25 May 2026; joining fee waived for the first 10 lakh customers up to ₹500 per RuPay card issued.
schemes.margin: Repayment, interest and any lender margin/fees
schemes.access: Ask a participating bank/lender for the Micro Credit Card product and confirm operational availability.
schemes.caution: The guarantee protects the lender, not the borrower; pricing, drawing power and documentation are lender-determined.

schemes.name: Self-Reliant India (SRI) Fund
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: MSME growth equity
schemes.bestFor: Growth capital for a scalable MSME with an investible business plan
schemes.eligible: Eligible growth-oriented MSME selected by an empanelled Daughter Fund
schemes.benefit: Fund-of-Funds route rather than a grant. The ₹50,000 crore architecture uses a Government Mother Fund and empanelled Daughter Funds. Budget 2026-27 provided a further allocation to the SRI Fund alongside a new ₹10,000 crore SME Growth Fund.
schemes.access: Approach an empanelled Daughter Fund/fund manager with an investment memorandum; the MSME does not receive an automatic Government cheque.
schemes.agency: NSIC Venture Capital Fund / Daughter Fund
schemes.caution: Selection, valuation, governance rights and exit terms are commercial; this is unsuitable for a business seeking only debt or subsidy.

schemes.name: MSME Innovative – Incubation, Design and IPR
schemes.status: Active - bank or continuous route
schemes.label: MSME innovation / design / IP
schemes.bestFor: Prototype, product redesign, patent/trademark/design protection or incubation
schemes.eligible: Udyam-registered MSME for Design/IPR; innovative ideas are routed through an approved Host Institute under Incubation
schemes.benefit: Incubation: up to ₹15 lakh per approved idea through a Host Institute, plus up to ₹1 crore to the Host Institute for relevant plant and machinery. Design: 75% of project cost for micro and 60% for small/medium enterprises, up to ₹40 lakh; student design projects up to ₹2.5 lakh. IPR reimbursement caps: ₹5 lakh foreign patent, ₹1 lakh domestic patent, ₹2 lakh GI, ₹15,000 design and ₹10,000 trademark.
schemes.margin: Component-specific balance and approved actual cost
schemes.access: Use the MSME Innovative portal; for Incubation first work through an approved Host Institute, and for Design coordinate with an Implementing Agency.
schemes.agency: MSME Ministry / Host Institute / Implementing Agency
schemes.caution: Each vertical has a different route and admissible cost; approval must precede expenditure where required.

schemes.name: NSIC Raw Material Assistance against Bank Guarantee
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: MSME working capital / inputs
schemes.bestFor: Bulk or timely purchase of indigenous or imported raw material
schemes.eligible: Creditworthy MSME able to provide an acceptable bank guarantee
schemes.benefit: NSIC can finance raw-material purchase for up to 180 days against a bank guarantee. The last publicly documented rate schedule (effective 1 July 2025) ran from 8.75% p.a. for micro units rated SME 1 to 10.25% p.a. for unrated units, with a processing fee of 1% p.a. on new sanctions and 0.5%-1% on renewals, and an additional 1.25% per quarter on repayment beyond 180 days. NSIC revises these rates periodically - confirm the live rate circular before relying on any figure.
schemes.margin: Bank guarantee, interest, fee and repayment
schemes.access: Submit the prescribed application to the nearest NSIC branch; NSIC appraises and inspects the unit before sanction.
schemes.caution: Not a subsidy; delayed repayment loses concessional pricing and attracts penal charges.

schemes.name: NSIC Single Point Registration Scheme (SPRS)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Government procurement / MSE
schemes.bestFor: Tender access and procurement-policy benefits for eligible products/services
schemes.eligible: Udyam-registered micro or small manufacturing/service enterprise meeting inspection and activity rules
schemes.benefit: Free tender sets, EMD exemption, tender consortia and the opportunity for an L1+15% MSE to match L1 for up to 25% of requirement, subject to tender and policy terms.
schemes.access: Apply online through NSIC SPRS and complete financial/technical inspection.
schemes.caution: Manufacture of medicines/drugs is excluded except Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy; traders are also excluded. Pharma units should use GeM/tender-specific MSE provisions instead.

schemes.name: MSE Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for delayed payments
schemes.status: Active - bank or continuous route
schemes.label: MSE receivables / dispute resolution
schemes.bestFor: Recovery or settlement of delayed buyer dues
schemes.eligible: Udyam- or Udyam Assist-registered micro or small enterprise with a commercial payment dispute
schemes.benefit: Online filing, pre-MSEFC negotiation and digital conciliation/arbitration support; the scheme also provides component-based legal support rather than a fixed cash award.
schemes.access: File on the MSME ODR portal with invoice, supply acceptance, correspondence and buyer details.
schemes.caution: This does not guarantee recovery; limitation, jurisdiction, contract evidence and enforcement remain important.

schemes.name: Export Promotion Mission – Niryat Protsahan finance interventions
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: MSME exports
schemes.bestFor: Pre/post-shipment export credit, factoring and collateral support
schemes.eligible: Eligible MSME exporter with IEC/Udyam and qualifying export-credit facility/intervention
schemes.benefit: Interest subvention of 2.75% p.a. on eligible rupee pre- and post-shipment export credit, capped at ₹50 lakh per IEC per financial year (same rate and cap for export factoring and e-commerce export credit). Separate collateral-free guarantee intervention covers 85% for micro and small and 65% for medium enterprises, up to ₹10 crore per exporter per year. From 1 April 2026 Exim Bank, not RBI, processes interest-subvention claims.
schemes.margin: Residual interest, lender margin and export-risk obligations
schemes.access: Apply through the export-credit bank and the notified Export Promotion Mission intervention; confirm product/country and claim-period eligibility.
schemes.caution: Do not assume every export loan or shipment qualifies; RBI/lender instructions, exporter status and intervention dates control.

schemes.name: Export Promotion Mission – TRACE and Niryat Disha market-readiness support
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: MSME exports / compliance
schemes.bestFor: International testing, inspection, certification, branding, market access, logistics or warehousing
schemes.eligible: Exporter meeting the relevant intervention criteria; TRACE requires valid IEC and Udyam for MSME support
schemes.benefit: TRACE: assistance of 75% of actual cost net of taxes or ₹25 lakh, whichever is lower, for a certification on the notified Positive List, with an annual cap of ₹25 lakh per exporter. Related Niryat Disha interventions include LIFT freight reimbursement of up to 30% of actual cost capped at ₹20 lakh per IEC per year (Himalayan states are a covered low-export zone), FLOW overseas-warehousing support at the lower of 30% of approved project cost or ₹10 crore, and market-access support of up to ₹5 crore per event.
schemes.access: Use the notified Export Promotion Mission intervention or participating Export Promotion Council/implementing channel before incurring cost.
schemes.agency: Department of Commerce / EPC / implementing agency
schemes.caution: Only notified certifications, activities, destinations and claim periods qualify; avoid treating the Mission as one blanket reimbursement.

schemes.name: Revamped Pharmaceutical Technology Upgradation Assistance Scheme (RPTUAS)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Pharmaceutical manufacturing
schemes.bestFor: Upgrade an existing pharma plant to Revised Schedule M and/or WHO-GMP
schemes.eligible: Existing pharmaceutical manufacturing unit with average turnover below ₹500 crore over the preceding 3 years
schemes.benefit: 20% of eligible investment for turnover below ₹50 crore; 15% for ₹50 crore to below ₹250 crore; 10% for ₹250 crore to below ₹500 crore; maximum incentive ₹2 crore per unit (raised from ₹1 crore by corrigendum of 17 September 2024). Assistance is a reimbursement, not credit-linked. Eligible investment is that made after 1 January 2024.
schemes.access: Monitor the Department of Pharmaceuticals SPI page/portal and obtain confirmation that fresh intake has reopened before committing upgrade expenditure.
schemes.caution: As of 4 August 2026, a temporary restriction remained while extension was considered; 21 HP applications were pending. Drug licences, Schedule M/WHO-GMP certification and two-stage verification apply.

schemes.name: Assistance to Pharmaceutical Industry for Common Facilities (API-CF)
schemes.status: Fresh window closed
schemes.label: Pharma cluster infrastructure
schemes.bestFor: Common testing, R&D, effluent/waste, logistics or other approved cluster facility
schemes.eligible: SPV with at least 5 legally independent pharma units; pharma enterprises hold at least 51% equity, or eligible State cluster entity
schemes.benefit: In Himachal/Himalayan States, up to 90% of approved common-infrastructure project cost or ₹20 crore per cluster, whichever is lower.
schemes.access: Form/strengthen the SPV and monitor the SPI scheme page for a fresh API-CF application window before preparing the final DPR.
schemes.caution: Latest located fresh window closed in January 2025; the 4 August 2026 official update reported no HP proposal pending under API-CF. Not an individual-unit grant.

schemes.name: SMDI – Marginal Investment Scheme for Reducing Import Dependence (MIS-RID)
schemes.status: Open now
schemes.label: Medical devices / components
schemes.bestFor: Manufacture eligible device components, medical-grade raw materials/accessories or notified import-dependent devices
schemes.eligible: Eligible Indian company/LLP/SPV or Government entity manufacturing a notified eligible product
schemes.benefit: One-time subsidy on eligible fixed investment: turnover up to ₹250 crore, 20%; ₹250–₹1,000 crore, 15%; above ₹1,000 crore, 10%; maximum ₹10 crore.
schemes.access: Use the SMDI portal only against a live notice and obtain product/category confirmation before investment.
schemes.caution: The June/July 2026 call closed on 24 July 2026. Incentive follows commissioning and verification; land is excluded and device/product eligibility is narrow.

schemes.name: SMDI – Medical Device Clinical Studies Support
schemes.family: Quality testing certification IP and compliance
schemes.status: Open now
schemes.label: Medical-device R&D / regulatory studies
schemes.bestFor: Indian pre-clinical study, clinical investigation, PMCF or new-IVD performance evaluation
schemes.eligible: Eligible medical-device manufacturer/developer meeting Indian regulatory and study conditions
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of 25% of expenditure in every category, subject to: pre-clinical (animal) studies up to ₹2 crore; clinical investigation up to ₹5 crore; post-market clinical follow-up up to ₹1 crore; in-vitro diagnostic performance evaluation up to ₹1 crore.
schemes.access: Secure CDSCO/ethics and other required permissions, then apply through SMDI only during a live call.
schemes.agency: Department of Pharmaceuticals / SMDI PMA / CDSCO
schemes.caution: The July 2026 call is closed. Funding does not replace regulatory approval and is reimbursed only for admissible Indian studies and verified milestones.

schemes.name: SMDI – Common Facilities for Medical Device Clusters
schemes.family: Quality testing certification IP and compliance
schemes.status: Open now
schemes.label: Medical-device cluster / testing infrastructure
schemes.bestFor: Shared production/testing/R&D/effluent/logistics facility or independent testing facility
schemes.eligible: SPV with at least 5 medical-device units and at least 51% enterprise equity, State entity or eligible testing institution
schemes.benefit: Common facility: 70% for Government-funded entity or 50% for private entity, up to ₹20 crore. Testing facility: 70% Government or 50% private, up to ₹5 crore.
schemes.access: Prepare a cluster DPR and apply through SMDI only under a live call.
schemes.caution: The July 2026 proposal window has closed. It is not a grant to one factory and requires shared-access governance and sustainable operations.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana – Jan Aushadhi Kendra
schemes.status: Active - bank or continuous route
schemes.label: Generic medicine retail / healthcare enterprise
schemes.bestFor: Open and operate a compliant Jan Aushadhi Kendra
schemes.eligible: Individual, NGO, society, trust, firm, private company, PACS or other eligible entity meeting premises, drug-licence and pharmacist rules
schemes.benefit: Normal incentive 20% of monthly purchases, capped at ₹20,000 a month and ₹5 lakh in total. A new Kendra opened by a woman, Divyangjan, SC or ST entrepreneur, or in an aspirational district, Himalayan state (Himachal Pradesh qualifies), island territory or the North East, additionally receives a one-time incentive of up to ₹2 lakh - ₹1.5 lakh for furniture and fixtures and ₹0.5 lakh for IT equipment - against original bills.
schemes.margin: Premises, pharmacist, licence, stock and working capital
schemes.access: Apply on the official Jan Aushadhi portal; after initial approval obtain the drug licence, execute agreements and complete store-code requirements.
schemes.caution: This is regulated medicine retail, not pharmaceutical manufacturing. Reimbursement is actual-cost based and operational incentives depend on purchase/stock compliance.

schemes.name: Himachal Pradesh Bulk Drug Park – Haroli, Una
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Bulk drugs / APIs / KSMs
schemes.bestFor: Locate an eligible bulk-drug/API unit inside the developing common-infrastructure park
schemes.eligible: Prospective park allottee/investor meeting the State implementing agency's product, environmental, land and investment conditions
schemes.benefit: Government has sanctioned ₹1,000 crore for common infrastructure at the 1,405-acre Haroli park, including ZLD-CETP, solvent recovery, utilities, warehousing and testing. This lowers shared-infrastructure burden; it is not a ₹1,000 crore grant to an allottee.
schemes.margin: Land, factory, plant, approvals and user charges
schemes.access: Use the HP Industries Single Window/park implementing agency for current plot allotment, utility tariff and project conditions.
schemes.agency: HP Bulk Drug Park Infrastructure Ltd. / Industries Department
schemes.caution: Common facilities are still under development. Obtain the live allotment notice, utility schedule, environmental category and any State incentive order in writing.

schemes.name: Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Biotechnology / life sciences / agri-biotech
schemes.bestFor: Early proof-of-concept for biotech, drug, vaccine, diagnostics, device, industrial-biotech or agri-biotech innovation
schemes.eligible: Eligible individual innovator/entrepreneur or qualifying startup routed through a BIG Partner under current guidelines
schemes.benefit: Up to ₹50 lakh for up to 18 months to establish proof of concept; milestone-based with mentoring through BIG Partners.
schemes.access: Apply through a BIG Partner during the call normally announced on 1 January and 1 July.
schemes.caution: Only innovative PoC work is supported; routine manufacturing, late-stage clinical validation and low-novelty projects are excluded.

schemes.name: Innovations for Defence Excellence (iDEX / SPARK)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Defence / aerospace / dual-use innovation
schemes.bestFor: Prototype or commercialise a solution to an iDEX/DISC/Open/PRIME/ADITI challenge
schemes.eligible: DPIIT startup, eligible Indian MSME/company or individual innovator under the specific challenge
schemes.benefit: DISC/Open Challenge and SPARK support up to ₹1.5 crore per project; iDEX PRIME up to ₹10 crore; ADITI up to ₹25 crore, subject to the challenge and approved product-development budget. The iDEX scheme framework was sanctioned for 2021-22 to 2025-26 - confirm the current sanction before planning around it.
schemes.access: Register on iDEX and apply to a live problem statement before its deadline.
schemes.caution: Competitive challenge funding, not a general defence-manufacturing subsidy; award, milestones, security/IP terms and procurement are separate decisions.

schemes.name: DRDO Technology Development Fund (TDF)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Defence / national-security / dual-use technology
schemes.bestFor: Develop or upgrade a technology/prototype against a notified defence requirement
schemes.eligible: Indian MSME/startup/eligible industry; MSME or Startup recognition is required for portal industry registration
schemes.benefit: Grant-in-aid of up to 90% of total project cost, with a maximum of ₹50 crore per project (raised from ₹10 crore). Funding is released against agreed milestones.
schemes.margin: Industry share, bank guarantee and cost overruns
schemes.access: Register on TDF portal and submit against an open project requirement with the prescribed PDD/DPR.
schemes.caution: Funding is requirement- and milestone-driven; consortium, foreign holding, academia share, security and bank-guarantee rules apply.

schemes.name: Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS) – Target Segment D
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Electronics components / capital equipment
schemes.bestFor: Electronics supply-chain inputs or capital goods used in electronics manufacturing
schemes.eligible: Applicant meeting the notified Segment D product, investment, net-worth and domestic-value-addition conditions
schemes.benefit: Segment D (supply-chain ecosystem and capital equipment) is eligible for turnover-linked, capex and hybrid incentives. The Segment D application window remains open to 30 April 2027; windows for Segments A, B, C and E closed on 30 September 2025. Turnover-linked incentive runs 6 years with a 1-year gestation; capex incentive runs 5 years.
schemes.margin: Minimum investment and balance project finance
schemes.access: Apply on the ECMS portal with product classification, committed investment and financial-capability evidence.
schemes.caution: Segments A, B, C and E are closed. Segment D thresholds and product list are narrow; do not assume ordinary electronics assembly qualifies.

schemes.name: RoSCTL – Rebate of State and Central Taxes and Levies
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Apparel / made-ups exports
schemes.bestFor: Rebate embedded taxes/levies on eligible exported apparel and made-ups
schemes.eligible: Eligible exporter of notified tariff lines complying with Customs/DGFT procedure
schemes.benefit: Product/tariff-line rate as notified under RoSCTL. The scheme was extended up to 30 September 2026 or until approval of the scheme for the 16th Finance Commission cycle, whichever is earlier (notified 1 April 2026).
schemes.margin: Normal export production and compliance cost
schemes.access: Claim through the prescribed Customs shipping-bill/DGFT process for eligible exports.
schemes.caution: Time-limited extension; rate, cap and eligibility depend on tariff line and shipment date. Recheck after 30 September 2026.

schemes.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
schemes.status: Active - bank or continuous route
schemes.label: Agri infrastructure
schemes.bestFor: Post-harvest, community farming and eligible agri-infrastructure projects
schemes.eligible: Farmers, agri-entrepreneurs, startups, FPOs, PACS, SHGs, cooperatives and eligible agencies
schemes.benefit: 3% interest subvention on loan up to ₹2 crore for up to 7 years; credit-guarantee fee support up to ₹2 crore; moratorium up to 2 years subject to project.
schemes.access: Apply on AIF portal and select participating lender.
schemes.caution: Only eligible infrastructure; working capital alone is not covered.

schemes.name: Formation and Promotion of 10,000 FPOs
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: FPO / producer enterprise
schemes.bestFor: Formation, handholding, equity strengthening and credit access
schemes.eligible: Eligible Farmer Producer Organisation/Company under the programme
schemes.benefit: Matching equity grant up to ₹15 lakh per FPO (₹2,000 per farmer member), management-cost support up to ₹18 lakh per FPO over 3 years, and a credit-guarantee facility of up to ₹2 crore per FPO project loan.
schemes.access: Engage with the assigned CBBO/SFAC/NABARD/NCDC implementing agency.
schemes.caution: The programme's target of 10,000 FPOs was reported achieved in February 2025, so support is now weighted towards handholding existing FPOs. Confirm with the State implementing agency whether fresh FPO formation is still being sanctioned before building a plan around it. Equity grant is matched against member equity actually raised.

schemes.name: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres (ACABC)
schemes.status: Active - bank or continuous route
schemes.label: Agri services / entrepreneurship
schemes.bestFor: Agri advisory, input/service and agribusiness venture by trained graduate
schemes.eligible: Eligible agriculture/allied graduate or specified diploma holder completing MANAGE training
schemes.benefit: Composite subsidy of 36% of project cost for the general category and 44% for women, SC/ST, PwD and all candidates from NE and hill states - Himachal Pradesh applicants qualify for 44%. Project ceiling ₹20 lakh for an individual (₹25 lakh for an exceptionally successful venture) and ₹100 lakh for a group of at least 5 trained persons. Subsidy is credit-linked and requires the venture to deliver extension services.
schemes.access: Complete approved ACABC training, prepare DPR and obtain bank sanction.
schemes.caution: Confirm current project-cost norm and training eligibility before relying on the ceiling.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) / Modified Interest Subvention Scheme
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Crop + allied working capital
schemes.bestFor: Short-term crop production and eligible animal husbandry/fisheries working capital
schemes.eligible: Eligible farmer/fisher/livestock owner under KCC norms
schemes.benefit: KCC limit under the Modified Interest Subvention Scheme enhanced from ₹3 lakh to ₹5 lakh with effect from FY2025-26. Eligible short-term loans carry 7% p.a.; a 3% prompt repayment incentive brings the effective rate to 4%. Government pays lending institutions 1.5% interest subvention. Collateral-free agricultural loan limit is ₹2 lakh per borrower, effective 1 January 2025.
schemes.access: Apply to bank/RRB/cooperative bank; use JanSamarth where enabled.
schemes.caution: The ₹5 lakh KCC/MISS limit includes allied activities; interest benefit, drawing power and security still follow the current lender/RBI instructions.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.family: Insurance risk compensation and income support
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Crop insurance
schemes.bestFor: Notified food/oilseed/commercial crops against insured perils
schemes.eligible: Farmer growing notified crop in notified area
schemes.benefit: Farmer premium capped at 2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi and 5% annual commercial/horticultural crops; balance actuarial premium subsidised by Government.
schemes.access: Enrol through notified insurer, bank or CSC before season cut-off.
schemes.caution: Voluntary participation, but crop/area/date and claim process are season-specific.

schemes.name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Farm mechanisation
schemes.bestFor: Notified machinery, custom-hiring centres and mechanisation interventions
schemes.eligible: Farmers/groups/FPOs/entrepreneurs; component-specific
schemes.benefit: Common machinery assistance is 40%–50% of benchmark cost; custom-hiring and special components have separate norms.
schemes.access: Apply through HP Agriculture Department under current SMAM target.
schemes.caution: Separate this central component from HP's Rajya Krishi Yantrikaran Yojana.

schemes.name: National Bamboo Mission
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Bamboo / agroforestry
schemes.bestFor: Plantation, nursery, treatment, processing and market infrastructure
schemes.eligible: Farmers, FPOs, entrepreneurs and institutions by component
schemes.benefit: Component-wise assistance under current NBM cost norms; private and public support patterns differ.
schemes.access: Apply through HP Agriculture Department/nodal agency.
schemes.caution: Confirm that species, land type and component are eligible in HP's annual plan.

schemes.name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (PM-RKVY)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agriculture and allied
schemes.bestFor: State-approved innovation, infrastructure and value-chain projects
schemes.eligible: State agencies, institutions, groups and selected beneficiaries under approved project
schemes.benefit: No universal individual percentage; benefit follows an approved State DPR/component.
schemes.access: Track HP Agriculture notifications/approved project calls.
schemes.caution: Enabling/project umbrella, not a flat farmer subsidy.

schemes.name: ATMA – Support to State Extension Programmes
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agriculture extension
schemes.bestFor: Training, demonstrations, exposure and farmer-group capacity
schemes.eligible: Selected farmers/groups under district extension plan
schemes.benefit: Programme-funded extension activity; no standard capital-grant ceiling.
schemes.access: Contact district ATMA/Agriculture office for calendar and selection.
schemes.caution: Training/extension, not business finance.

schemes.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana / Natural Farming component
schemes.status: Active - cluster or project area
schemes.label: Organic/natural farming
schemes.bestFor: Cluster conversion, inputs, certification/verification and marketing
schemes.eligible: Farmers organised in approved clusters
schemes.benefit: Assistance follows current cluster guidelines and State action plan; no single standalone enterprise cap.
schemes.access: Join an approved cluster through Agriculture Department.
schemes.caution: Avoid double-claiming the same cost under State natural-farming support.

schemes.name: NHB Commercial Horticulture Development
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Commercial horticulture
schemes.bestFor: Commercial production in open/protected conditions
schemes.eligible: Eligible individual/entity for a bankable eligible project under current NHB/MIDH norms
schemes.benefit: In HP/Himalayan area, subsidy commonly 50% of eligible project cost under current component norms; project ceiling and cost norm vary by crop/structure.
schemes.margin: Balance project cost and bank margin
schemes.access: Apply online to NHB and obtain term-loan sanction before project execution as required.
schemes.caution: Use the latest operational guideline and 2026 amendment; old generic ceilings in the CSV were not dependable.

schemes.name: NHB Integrated Post-Harvest Management
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Horticulture post-harvest
schemes.bestFor: Packhouse, grading, ripening, primary processing and eligible logistics
schemes.eligible: Eligible individual/entity with bankable project
schemes.benefit: Component-wise subsidy and cost ceiling under current MIDH/NHB norms; HP generally receives Himalayan-area rate.
schemes.access: Apply through NHB portal/bank under the relevant component.
schemes.caution: A generic 'integrated packhouse' row should be treated as this component, not a separate HP scheme.

schemes.name: NHB Cold Storage / Controlled Atmosphere Storage
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Cold chain / horticulture
schemes.bestFor: Eligible cold storage and CA infrastructure
schemes.eligible: Eligible entrepreneur/entity with technical approvals and bankable project
schemes.benefit: Assistance follows capacity, technology and cost norms; Himalayan-area rates apply where specified in current guidelines.
schemes.access: Seek technical appraisal, NHB application and bank sanction before construction.
schemes.caution: Cold storage and CA storage are components, not two universal fixed-cap schemes.

schemes.name: MIDH mushroom production/spawn/compost units
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Mushroom
schemes.bestFor: Commercial mushroom production, spawn or compost unit
schemes.eligible: Eligible grower/entrepreneur under MIDH component and bank/department norms
schemes.benefit: 2025 MIDH cost norms for Himalayan states provide 50% assistance on benchmark costs; commercial component cost norms include mushroom production ₹30 lakh, spawn ₹20 lakh and compost ₹30 lakh, subject to component limits.
schemes.access: Apply through Horticulture Department or NHB route specified for project size.
schemes.caution: The original HP mushroom rates were not adequately sourced; use the current component guideline.

schemes.name: National Livestock Mission – Entrepreneurship Development Programme
schemes.status: Active - bank or continuous route
schemes.label: Livestock / fodder
schemes.bestFor: Poultry, sheep/goat, piggery and fodder entrepreneurship components
schemes.eligible: Eligible individual, SHG, FPO, cooperative, Section 8 company or JLG by component
schemes.benefit: 50% capital subsidy on eligible project cost, with component ceilings: rural poultry (parent farm/hatchery) ₹25 lakh; sheep and goat breeding ₹50 lakh; piggery ₹30 lakh; feed and fodder entrepreneurship ₹50 lakh; fodder seed processing and grading ₹50 lakh. Balance is met through bank loan or self-finance; subsidy is released in two equal instalments through SIDBI.
schemes.access: Apply on NLM portal with bank sanction/DPR as prescribed.
schemes.caution: Use the January 2025 component guideline for the exact unit size and cap.

schemes.name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission – breed multiplication/IVF/sex-sorted semen
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Dairy genetics
schemes.bestFor: Breed multiplication farm and advanced bovine breeding technologies
schemes.eligible: Entrepreneur/agency/farmer depending on component
schemes.benefit: Under the revised mission (approved March 2025, outlay ₹3,400 crore up to FY2025-26): heifer rearing centres receive one-time assistance of 35% of capital cost; farmers receive up to 50% of the cost of sex-sorted semen; and 3% interest subvention is available on loans to induct high-genetic-merit IVF-born heifers. Most other components are 100% grant-in-aid. The earlier breed-multiplication-farm component offered 50% of project cost or ₹2 crore, whichever is lower, for a farm of at least 200 milch animals - confirm with DAHD whether that component is still open.
schemes.access: Use DAHD/RGM portal and State Animal Husbandry channel for the relevant component.
schemes.caution: Component continuation/target must be confirmed after FY2025-26 allocation.

schemes.name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF)
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Fresh window closed
schemes.label: Dairy/meat/feed/vaccine infrastructure
schemes.bestFor: Processing, feed, breed/vaccine, waste-to-wealth and related infrastructure
schemes.eligible: Eligible MSME, FPO, private company, Section 8 company and individual entrepreneur under guidelines
schemes.benefit: Loan up to 90% of project cost from scheduled banks and financial institutions; 3% interest subvention for 8 years including a 2-year moratorium; credit-guarantee cover of up to 25% of borrowed credit for eligible MSME and dairy-cooperative projects from a ₹750 crore guarantee fund.
schemes.access: Check portal/DAHD notice and lender before preparing a fresh application.
schemes.caution: Official approval was stated through 31 March 2026; as of verification, a fresh post-March-2026 sanction window was not confirmed.

schemes.name: Supporting Dairy Cooperatives and Farmer Producer Organisations (SDCFPO)
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Dairy cooperative finance
schemes.bestFor: Working capital for dairy cooperatives/FPOs
schemes.eligible: Eligible dairy cooperative/FPO/producer-owned institution
schemes.benefit: Additional 2% interest subvention for prompt repayment under current administrative approval; credit amount is need/lender based.
schemes.access: Apply through NDDB/NCDC route and participating lender as notified.
