schemes.caution: Not an individual dairy-farmer capital subsidy.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) – beneficiary activities
schemes.status: Fresh window closed
schemes.label: Fisheries / aquaculture
schemes.bestFor: Eligible aquaculture, hatchery, cold chain, transport and fisheries activities
schemes.eligible: Fish farmer, entrepreneur, SHG/JLG, cooperative, SC/ST/women and other eligible categories by activity
schemes.benefit: Government assistance generally 40% of eligible unit cost for general category and 60% for SC/ST/women, subject to activity cost norm and State target.
schemes.access: Apply through HP Fisheries Department during the annual activity window.
schemes.caution: A live State target/sanction is necessary; the national base guideline alone does not guarantee intake.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana (PM-MKSSY)
schemes.family: Insurance risk compensation and income support
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Fisheries formalisation
schemes.bestFor: Registration, digital identity, insurance, value-chain performance and microenterprise formalisation
schemes.eligible: Fishers, fisheries microenterprises and value-chain participants under component rules
schemes.benefit: Component-specific performance grants, insurance and digital/formalisation support; no single universal capital percentage.
schemes.access: Register through Fisheries Department/National Fisheries Digital Platform and current component channel.
schemes.caution: Use the specific subcomponent guideline.

schemes.name: Fisheries and Aquaculture Infrastructure Development Fund (FIDF)
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Fresh window closed
schemes.label: Fisheries infrastructure
schemes.bestFor: Large fisheries/harbour/hatchery/cold-chain infrastructure
schemes.eligible: Eligible State entity, cooperative, entrepreneur and other approved entity
schemes.benefit: Loan up to 80% of estimated/actual project cost with at least 20% beneficiary margin money (waived for State/UT projects); interest subvention up to 3% p.a.; nodal lending entities charge not lower than 5% p.a.; repayment up to 12 years including a 2-year moratorium.
schemes.margin: At least 20% margin money (waived for projects implemented by a State/UT), plus any gap
schemes.access: Check current FIDF portal/Department of Fisheries before a fresh proposal.
schemes.caution: Published extension ran through 31 March 2026; fresh proposal status after that date was not confirmed.

schemes.name: PM Kisan SAMPADA Yojana – current component calls
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Food processing infrastructure
schemes.bestFor: Integrated cold chain, processing capacity, agro-cluster, food safety/R&D and Operation Greens components when notified
schemes.eligible: Eligible entity under the specific Expression of Interest
schemes.benefit: Grant rate and ceiling depend on the live component guideline/EOI; selected 2026 calls remain open/extended for specific infrastructure such as irradiation.
schemes.access: Respond only to a live MoFPI EOI on the official portal.
schemes.caution: Mega Food Parks and backward/forward-linkage components are not open as generic new schemes; use live calls only.

schemes.name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Micro food processing
schemes.bestFor: Formalisation and upgradation of micro food-processing units
schemes.eligible: Individual micro unit, SHG member, FPO/cooperative and common infrastructure entity by component
schemes.benefit: Individual unit: 35% credit-linked grant up to ₹10 lakh; SHG seed capital ₹40,000 per member; common infrastructure 35%; branding/marketing up to 50% subject to guidelines.
schemes.margin: Typically 10% beneficiary contribution for individual unit plus loan
schemes.access: Check HP PMFME/DIC and portal for a currently open intake.
schemes.caution: Extended only through September 2026 as of verification; a proposal to continue the scheme for five more years with revised norms (including a higher per-unit subsidy cap and priority for women and hilly-region entrepreneurs) was pending. Confirm a live State intake with the HP nodal agency/DIC before committing expenditure. The 35% grant is credit-linked - a sanctioned bank loan is a precondition.

schemes.name: NABARD Refinance Scheme for affordable credit to food-processing units
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Food processing finance
schemes.bestFor: Cheaper bank term credit for a unit already granted MoFPI assistance
schemes.eligible: Food-processing unit with MoFPI grant and standard eligible term loan through an eligible bank
schemes.benefit: HP loans may be refinanced by NABARD up to 100%; end-borrower lending rate must not exceed 10% p.a.; eligible banking-system loan limit ₹100 crore per borrower; refinance tenor up to 7 years.
schemes.access: Ask the eligible financing bank to claim NABARD refinance; the unit does not receive refinance directly.
schemes.caution: Only units already provided a MoFPI grant qualify; benefit should be passed through by the bank.

schemes.name: NCDC assistance to cooperatives
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Cooperative agri/food/livestock
schemes.bestFor: Processing, storage, marketing, dairy, poultry and other eligible cooperative projects
schemes.eligible: Eligible cooperative through direct or State route
schemes.benefit: Need-based project finance; subsidy/grant, where available, is programme- and category-specific rather than universal.
schemes.access: Prepare DPR and apply to NCDC through appropriate direct/State channel.
schemes.caution: Treat NCDC as a financing institution/route, not a fixed-rate subsidy scheme.

schemes.name: HP SC/ST Development Corporation – Swarojgar Yojana
schemes.status: Active - bank or continuous route
schemes.label: SC/ST self-employment
schemes.bestFor: Small income-generating activity
schemes.eligible: SC/ST bonafide Himachali aged 18-55 with annual family income up to ₹50,000 and no default at a financial institution
schemes.support: Capital subsidy + interest subsidy + bank loan
schemes.benefit: Bank-financed project up to ₹50,000; capital subsidy 50% of project cost up to ₹10,000; effective interest 4%–6% for regular repayment.
schemes.access: Apply to HP SC/ST Development Corporation/district channel and financing bank.
schemes.caution: The portal's low income threshold is restrictive and should be reconfirmed with the Corporation.

schemes.name: NSTFDC Term Loan Scheme
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: ST enterprise
schemes.bestFor: Viable industrial, agricultural or service venture
schemes.eligible: Eligible Scheduled Tribe applicant; family-income ceiling and State-channel rules apply
schemes.benefit: Unit cost up to ₹50 lakh; NSTFDC finance up to 90%. Beneficiary rate: 6% up to ₹5 lakh, 8% up to ₹10 lakh, 10% above ₹10 lakh; promoter contribution 0%–5% by project size.
schemes.access: Apply through HP SC/ST Development Corporation/participating bank as State channel.
schemes.caution: Channel availability and State allocation determine sanction.

schemes.name: NBCFDC General Loan Scheme
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: OBC / backward-class enterprise
schemes.bestFor: Agriculture, artisan, small business, transport or service activity
schemes.eligible: Member of a notified Backward Class with annual family income up to ₹3 lakh, through the State Channelising Agency
schemes.benefit: Up to 85% of project cost, maximum ₹15 lakh; beneficiary interest 6% up to ₹5 lakh, 7% above ₹5–₹10 lakh, 8% above ₹10–₹15 lakh; repayment up to 8 years.
schemes.margin: At least 15% unless channel adds finance
schemes.access: Apply through HP Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation/authorised channel.
schemes.caution: State-channel intake and security conditions apply.

schemes.name: NBCFDC New Swarnima for Women
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Women / OBC enterprise
schemes.bestFor: Small self-employment venture
schemes.eligible: Backward Class woman with annual family income up to ₹3 lakh, through the State Channelising Agency
schemes.benefit: Maximum ₹2 lakh; NBCFDC finance 95%; beneficiary interest 5% p.a.; no own contribution required for projects up to ₹2 lakh under scheme structure.
schemes.margin: No beneficiary contribution stated up to ₹2 lakh
schemes.access: Apply through HP Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation/authorised channel.
schemes.caution: Channel partner contributes 5%; sanction and local intake are not automatic.

schemes.name: NMDFC Term Loan Scheme
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Minority enterprise
schemes.bestFor: Viable agriculture, artisan, small business, technical trade or service venture
schemes.eligible: Eligible notified-minority applicant under Credit Line 1 or 2 income limit
schemes.benefit: Credit Line 1: loan up to ₹20 lakh at 6% p.a. for families with annual income up to ₹3 lakh. Credit Line 2: loan up to ₹30 lakh at 8% p.a. for men and 6% p.a. for women, for families with annual income up to ₹8 lakh. Repayment up to 5 years after a 6-month moratorium; typical finance pattern NMDFC:SCA:beneficiary 90:5:5.
schemes.access: Apply through HP Minorities Finance & Development Corporation/State Channelising Agency.
schemes.caution: Income line and annual State allocation determine eligibility; verify current HP intake.

schemes.name: Soil Health & Fertility / Soil Health Card
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agriculture / soil health
schemes.bestFor: Soil testing, soil-health cards and balanced nutrient recommendations
schemes.eligible: Farmers whose samples are covered by the district programme
schemes.benefit: Government-funded soil testing and soil-health card/advisory; HP's FY2025-26 programme budget was ₹3.92 crore. There is no standard cash payment to the farmer.
schemes.access: Contact the Agriculture Extension Officer or soil-testing laboratory for the district sampling schedule.
schemes.caution: Laboratory coverage and sample collection are programme based; the card is advisory, not a subsidy sanction.

schemes.name: Food & Nutrition Security / National Food Security Mission
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agriculture / field crops
schemes.bestFor: Rice, wheat, pulses, maize and nutri-cereals: demonstrations, seed, micronutrients and notified machinery
schemes.eligible: Farmers, groups and institutions selected under district crop targets
schemes.benefit: Component-wise subsidised seed, demonstrations, plant protection, micronutrients and machinery under the approved action plan; HP reported a ₹9.65 crore FY2025-26 programme.
schemes.access: Apply through the Agriculture Extension Officer under the notified crop/component and seasonal target.
schemes.caution: No single percentage applies across all inputs; the district crop plan and cost norm control assistance.

schemes.name: Sub-Mission on Seeds and Planting Material / Seed Village
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agriculture / seed production
schemes.bestFor: Certified seed distribution, seed production, seed villages and seed-chain strengthening
schemes.eligible: Farmers, seed growers, groups and approved seed institutions by component
schemes.benefit: Assistance follows crop-wise seed cost norms, production targets and quality controls; MKSY separately provides 50% on notified cereal/pulse/oilseed/fodder seed and 25% on potato/ginger/turmeric seed.
schemes.access: Register with Agriculture Department/seed agency before sowing for an approved seed-production or distribution component.
schemes.caution: Seed replacement and seed-production incentives are different components; certification and procurement conditions may apply.

schemes.name: Sub-Mission on Agroforestry
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agroforestry
schemes.bestFor: Trees on farms, nurseries, boundary/strip plantation and integrated tree-crop-livestock models
schemes.eligible: Farmers, groups, FPOs, nurseries and implementing institutions under the approved plan
schemes.benefit: Component-wise support for quality planting material, plantations and demonstration/cluster activities; HP reported ₹1.55 crore for the programme. No universal individual cash ceiling.
schemes.access: Apply through Agriculture Department after confirming species, land classification and district target.
schemes.caution: Tree-felling/transit rules and species suitability must be checked separately from subsidy eligibility.

schemes.name: National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF) – farmer incentive
schemes.status: Active - cluster or project area
schemes.label: Natural farming
schemes.bestFor: Adoption of natural-farming practices in an approved cluster
schemes.eligible: Registered participating farmer in an approved NMNF cluster
schemes.benefit: ₹4,000 per acre per year for 2 years, limited to 1 acre per farmer, subject to verified adoption/output and cluster implementation.
schemes.access: Join an approved cluster through Agriculture Department/ATMA and complete the required training and verification.
schemes.caution: Not an advance input subsidy; payment depends on programme registration, verification and State rollout. Avoid double claim for the same item under HP natural-farming support.

schemes.name: National Mission on Natural Farming – Bio-input Resource Centre
schemes.status: Active - cluster or project area
schemes.label: Natural farming enterprise
schemes.bestFor: Local production and supply of natural-farming bio-inputs
schemes.eligible: Eligible SHG, FPO, cooperative, local entrepreneur or institution selected for a BRC
schemes.benefit: Assistance up to ₹1 lakh per approved Bio-input Resource Centre under NMNF norms.
schemes.margin: Balance and operating needs as sanctioned
schemes.access: Respond to the Agriculture Department's cluster/BRC selection and submit the required proposal/site details.
schemes.caution: Selection is linked to an approved cluster plan; it is not an always-open ₹1 lakh grant.

schemes.name: National Mission on Edible Oils – Oilseeds (NMEO-Oilseeds)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Oilseeds / post-harvest
schemes.bestFor: Oilseed clusters, quality seed, demonstrations and small post-harvest units
schemes.eligible: Farmers in approved clusters; FPOs/cooperatives and eligible entities for infrastructure
schemes.benefit: Free quality seed in approved clusters; eligible post-harvest units can receive 33% of project cost, capped at ₹9.90 lakh, under the specified component.
schemes.access: Use Agriculture Department cluster route; infrastructure proposals are normally organised through the eligible group/entity.
schemes.caution: The 33% ceiling is for eligible post-harvest components, not every oilseed activity.

schemes.name: National Mission on Pulses
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Pulses / processing
schemes.bestFor: Pulse seed kits, productivity clusters, assured procurement and small processing/packaging units
schemes.eligible: Pulse growers in approved programme areas; FPOs/cooperatives/entrepreneurs for notified infrastructure
schemes.benefit: Free seed kits under programme targets; eligible processing and packaging units can receive 33% of project cost up to ₹25 lakh. Tur, urad and masoor procurement support operates under notified conditions.
schemes.access: Contact Agriculture Department for cluster/seed target; use the notified procurement or infrastructure proposal channel.
schemes.caution: Procurement is conditional on registration, quality, season and notified agency; the processing grant needs project sanction.

schemes.name: PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana – Bilaspur district convergence
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agriculture / convergence
schemes.bestFor: Productivity, diversification, irrigation, storage, credit and allied activities in the selected district
schemes.eligible: Farmers, groups and institutions in Bilaspur covered by the approved district plan
schemes.benefit: Bilaspur is the only selected Himachal Pradesh district. Benefits come through convergence of 36 existing schemes; there is no separate universal cash rate.
schemes.access: Contact Bilaspur district Agriculture office and ask which block/commodity interventions are in the approved action plan.
schemes.caution: Do not use this row as a standalone grant; eligibility and amount come from the underlying converged scheme.

schemes.name: RKVY Innovation & Agri-Entrepreneurship Programme
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agritech startup
schemes.bestFor: Idea validation, pre-seed and seed-stage agritech/agri-allied startup development
schemes.eligible: Selected agripreneur/startup through a designated RKVY agribusiness incubator
schemes.benefit: Idea/pre-seed grant up to ₹5 lakh with 90:10 support pattern; seed-stage grant up to ₹25 lakh with 85:15 pattern; orientation stipend ₹10,000/month for 2 months under the programme architecture.
schemes.margin: 10% pre-seed or 15% seed, plus ineligible cost
schemes.access: Apply to a designated RKVY-RAFTAAR agribusiness incubator during its cohort call.
schemes.caution: Competitive cohort selection and milestone disbursement apply; published caps are not automatic startup entitlements.

schemes.name: AgriSURE – Agri Fund for Startups & Rural Enterprises
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agritech / rural enterprise
schemes.bestFor: Scalable early-stage agriculture and rural-enterprise startup
schemes.eligible: DPIIT-recognised Indian startup meeting the fund's sector, stage and investment criteria
schemes.benefit: ₹750 crore fund architecture; direct-investment scheme can invest up to ₹25 crore in a selected startup, subject to fund diligence and terms.
schemes.access: Approach the AgriSURE investment manager/NABARD with pitch, DPIIT status, business plan and financial information.
schemes.caution: This is selective investment, not a subsidy or assured loan; ownership dilution/return terms may apply.

schemes.name: e-NAM – National Agriculture Market
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agriculture / market access
schemes.bestFor: Online sale through connected mandis, price discovery and electronic payment
schemes.eligible: Farmer/FPO/trader registered with an integrated e-NAM mandi under role-specific rules
schemes.benefit: No capital grant; provides online bidding, assaying/market information and direct electronic settlement where the mandi service is enabled.
schemes.access: Register on e-NAM and link with a participating mandi/FPO; complete KYC and commodity/lot requirements.
schemes.caution: Actual trading services vary by mandi; registration does not guarantee a buyer or minimum price.

schemes.name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for e-NWR based Pledge Financing (CGS-NPF)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Warehouse receipt finance
schemes.bestFor: Short-term credit against produce stored in a WDRA-registered warehouse and represented by electronic negotiable warehouse receipt
schemes.eligible: Eligible farmer, FPO, cooperative, MSME or trader through an onboarded lender
schemes.benefit: Backed by a ₹1,000 crore corpus. Eligible loan up to ₹75 lakh for agricultural purposes and up to ₹2 crore for MSMEs, traders, FPOs and farmer cooperatives. Guarantee cover for small and marginal farmers, women and SC/ST/PwD farmers is 85% for loans up to ₹3 lakh and 80% from ₹3 lakh to ₹75 lakh; all other borrowers get 75%.
schemes.margin: Lender margin/interest; stored produce is primary security
schemes.access: Store eligible produce in a WDRA warehouse, obtain e-NWR and apply to an onboarded bank for pledge finance.
schemes.caution: Guarantee protects the lender, not the borrower from repayment; commodity, warehouse, margin and lender appraisal rules apply.

schemes.name: PM-AASHA – Price Support / Price Deficiency routes
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Agriculture marketing / MSP
schemes.bestFor: Sale of notified pulses, oilseeds and copra when the approved support mechanism is activated
schemes.eligible: Registered growers of notified crop meeting quality and procurement conditions
schemes.benefit: Price Support Scheme procurement is activated on State request when market prices fall below MSP; Price Deficiency Payment Scheme may be used for notified oilseeds. Amount depends on crop, quantity and live notification.
schemes.access: Register with the notified procurement agency/portal during the crop-specific window.
schemes.caution: Not a permanent open procurement promise for every crop; quality, quantity, State proposal and dates control access.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN income support
schemes.family: Insurance risk compensation and income support
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Farmer income support
schemes.bestFor: Income support to eligible landholding farmer families
schemes.eligible: Eligible cultivable-landholding farmer family, subject to institutional/high-income and other exclusion categories
schemes.benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three ₹2,000 instalments after land, Aadhaar/e-KYC and bank validation.
schemes.access: Complete registration/e-KYC and correction through the official PM-KISAN portal/CSC and State land-record verification.
schemes.caution: It is household income support, not project finance; exclusions and land-record validation apply.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
schemes.family: Insurance risk compensation and income support
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Farmer pension
schemes.bestFor: Contributory old-age pension for eligible small and marginal farmers
schemes.eligible: Eligible small/marginal farmer aged 18–40, subject to scheme exclusions
schemes.benefit: Beneficiary contributes about ₹55–₹200 per month depending on entry age and Government contributes an equal amount; assured pension ₹3,000/month after age 60.
schemes.access: Enrol through CSC with Aadhaar, bank account and land/eligibility information.
schemes.caution: Voluntary pension, not a subsidy for farming activity; exit, spouse and default rules apply.

schemes.name: Himachal Pradesh Subtropical Horticulture, Irrigation and Value Addition Project (HP-SHIVA)
schemes.status: Active - cluster or project area
schemes.label: Subtropical horticulture
schemes.bestFor: Irrigation, orchard development, farmer organisation and value-chain support for subtropical fruits
schemes.eligible: Farm households/groups in selected clusters of Bilaspur, Hamirpur, Kangra, Mandi, Sirmaur, Solan and Una
schemes.benefit: Project targets about 15,000 farm households through approved clusters; benefit package follows cluster design and procurement, not a single cash percentage.
schemes.access: Ask the District Horticulture Office whether the village is in an HP-SHIVA cluster and which commodity package is approved.
schemes.caution: Not an open statewide reimbursement scheme; land pooling, group, irrigation and cluster conditions may apply.

schemes.name: Himachal Khumb Vikas Yojana
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Mushroom
schemes.bestFor: Small-scale mushroom production and notified mushroom infrastructure/components
schemes.eligible: Eligible grower/entrepreneur under current Horticulture Department target
schemes.benefit: Current eUdyan scheme route is active; exact State component rate and ceiling follow the current sanction/cost-norm circular. MIDH commercial norms are separately listed in Horticulture Components.
schemes.access: Apply on eUdyan/through District Horticulture Office before purchase or construction.
schemes.caution: Do not assume the MIDH commercial-unit norm automatically applies to the State Khumb component; confirm the route and avoid duplicate aid.

schemes.name: Mukhya Mantri Madhu Vikas Yojana
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Beekeeping
schemes.bestFor: Bee colonies/hives, apiary development and eligible bee-product activity
schemes.eligible: Eligible trained/registered beekeeper or entrepreneur meeting departmental documentation
schemes.benefit: Component-wise assistance under the current annual sanction; eUdyan route requires beekeeping training/breeder and purchase documentation. MIDH bee cost norms are separately listed in Horticulture Components.
schemes.access: Apply through eUdyan with Aadhaar, land/bank records, bills, registration, DPR and training/bee-breeder certificate as applicable.
schemes.caution: Confirm current unit cap and approved breeder/vendor before purchase; do not combine State and MIDH aid on the same hive/colony.

schemes.name: MEHAK – aromatic plants cultivation and processing
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Aromatic plants / processing
schemes.bestFor: Cultivation of notified aromatic crops and eligible primary processing/distillation activity
schemes.eligible: Eligible farmer, group or entrepreneur with land and project documents
schemes.benefit: Component-wise support at the current sanctioned benchmark; the official live procedure does not publish one reliable universal percentage.
schemes.access: Apply on eUdyan with Aadhaar, jamabandi, bank details, tatima/site record, DPR and self-declaration.
schemes.caution: Obtain the crop/component rate circular and technical approval before planting or buying distillation equipment.

schemes.name: Mukhya Mantri Greenhouse Renovation Scheme
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Protected cultivation
schemes.bestFor: Renovation/replacement of eligible ageing or damaged greenhouse components
schemes.eligible: Eligible protected-cultivation beneficiary meeting age, condition and inspection rules
schemes.benefit: Support follows the current approved renovation benchmark and departmental sanction; no current official statewide rate was stated in the live procedure reviewed.
schemes.access: Apply on eUdyan/through District Horticulture Office and obtain physical inspection before renovation.
schemes.caution: Do not rely on older historical percentages as a 2026 entitlement; age, prior subsidy, damage and component admissibility must be verified first.

schemes.name: Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojana (KUSHY) – anti-hail support structure
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Orchard protection
schemes.bestFor: Permanent support structure for anti-hail net and related approved orchard-protection works
schemes.eligible: Eligible orchardist with technically suitable site and sanctioned design
schemes.benefit: Current eUdyan route is active; structure support follows the annual State cost norm. MIDH separately provides a benchmark for anti-hail/bird net and permanent support, shown in Horticulture Components.
schemes.access: Apply through eUdyan before procurement/installation and follow the approved design/vendor specifications.
schemes.caution: The live procedure contains limited benefit detail; obtain a written current rate sheet and avoid claiming the same structure under two programmes.

schemes.name: National Beekeeping & Honey Mission (NBHM)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Beekeeping / honey value chain
schemes.bestFor: Scientific beekeeping, quality control, post-harvest, traceability and market/value-chain projects
schemes.eligible: Beekeeper group, FPO/cooperative, institution, entrepreneur or implementing agency under the relevant Mini Mission
schemes.benefit: Component-specific assistance through National Bee Board/approved project; no single universal individual percentage. Individual hive/colony norms under MIDH are separately listed.
schemes.access: Use National Bee Board/project call or State Horticulture channel for the relevant Mini Mission/component.
schemes.caution: Project approval and eligible component determine support; do not treat NBHM as an automatic per-hive payment.

schemes.name: National AYUSH Mission / NMPB medicinal-plant cultivation
schemes.status: Active - cluster or project area
schemes.label: Medicinal plants
schemes.bestFor: Cultivation of prioritised medicinal plants, nurseries and approved post-harvest/value-chain components
schemes.eligible: Farmers organised in approved clusters; growers/groups/agencies by component
schemes.benefit: Prioritised medicinal plants are grouped at 30%, 50% or 75% of cultivation cost norms under approved NAM plans; exact species, cluster, area and State target control the rate.
schemes.access: Check the NMPB prioritised species list and apply through the State AYUSH/medicinal-plants nodal agency before cultivation.
schemes.caution: Only listed species and approved clusters/components qualify; first secure buy-back/market feasibility because subsidy does not assure sale.

schemes.name: HP Sericulture support services
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Sericulture
schemes.bestFor: Mulberry planting material, chawki-reared silkworm supply, technical guidance and oak tasar/eri promotion
schemes.eligible: Sericulture farmers/groups in serviced areas subject to centre and season availability
schemes.benefit: Support is delivered through 79 Government Sericulture Centres/Chawki centres and 64 mulberry farms; benefit is programme/supply based rather than a universal cash rate.
schemes.access: Contact the nearest Sericulture Centre through the Industries/Sericulture wing before mulberry planting or rearing cycle.
schemes.caution: Silkworm/plant availability, climate, host plantation and crop calendar determine participation.

schemes.name: Livestock Insurance Programme – HP implementation
schemes.family: Insurance risk compensation and income support
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Livestock risk management
schemes.bestFor: Insurance of eligible cattle/buffalo and other notified livestock
schemes.eligible: Eligible livestock owner with tagged/identified animal under the current enrolment target
schemes.benefit: Premium assistance and cover follow the current district tender/policy and animal-value norms; no single current statewide percentage was reliably published in the source reviewed.
schemes.access: Ask the local Veterinary Institution for the current insurer, premium share, valuation, tagging and enrolment window.
schemes.caution: Cover starts only after valid enrolment/premium and identification; death intimation and post-mortem/claim timelines are strict.

schemes.name: Fisheries livelihood and nutritional support during fishing ban/lean period
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Fisheries livelihood support
schemes.bestFor: Saving-cum-relief support during notified lean/ban period
schemes.eligible: Registered eligible fisher who contributes the prescribed savings and meets programme rules
schemes.benefit: Beneficiary contribution is matched by Government and released during the notified lean period under PMMSY/State implementation; amount follows the current enrolment order. HP reported ₹1.63 crore to 3,616 fishers in FY2025-26.
schemes.access: Enrol through Fisheries Department/cooperative before the cut-off and maintain the required contribution schedule.
schemes.caution: Not a capital grant; missed contribution or registration deadlines can make the fisher ineligible for that cycle.

schemes.name: Him Ganga dairy programme
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Dairy / milk marketing
schemes.bestFor: Milk collection, producer organisation, procurement and dairy value-chain strengthening
schemes.eligible: Milk producers and dairy cooperative societies in covered routes/areas
schemes.benefit: Programme expands procurement and producer-owned dairy systems; individual benefit is mainly assured/organised market access and any notified milk support, not a universal capital subsidy.
schemes.access: Join/register with the local milk producer cooperative/collection route and verify current quality and procurement terms.
schemes.caution: Procurement coverage, quality testing, price and incentives change by route and notification.

schemes.name: National Programme for Dairy Development (NPDD) – HP projects
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Dairy infrastructure
schemes.bestFor: Milk testing, chilling, collection, quality and dairy cooperative/FPO strengthening
schemes.eligible: Eligible dairy cooperative, milk union, producer-owned institution or approved State implementing agency
schemes.benefit: Institutional project support under approved NPDD DPR; no direct fixed-rate grant to an individual dairy farmer.
schemes.access: Develop proposal through the dairy cooperative/Milkfed/State nodal agency under a live NPDD project.
schemes.caution: Institutional route only; farmers benefit through the supported collection/quality/value chain.

schemes.name: DAY-NRLM – SHG Revolving Fund, Community Investment Fund and interest support
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Rural livelihoods / women enterprise
schemes.bestFor: SHG working capital, livelihood activity and community-managed finance
schemes.eligible: Eligible women SHG/federation member under DAY-NRLM protocols
schemes.support: Capital support + interest subvention + bank linkage
schemes.benefit: Revolving Fund of ₹20,000-₹30,000 per eligible SHG; Community Investment Fund up to ₹2.5 lakh per SHG routed through the Cluster Level Federation; Vulnerability Reduction Fund of ₹1.5 lakh per Village Organisation; plus interest subvention (7% p.a. on SHG loans up to ₹3 lakh) and bank-credit support under current rules.
schemes.access: Join/grade through the block NRLM mission and village/cluster federation before seeking RF/CIF or bank linkage.
schemes.caution: Funds are community/institution routed and usually revolving; individual members do not automatically receive the full SHG ceiling.

schemes.name: Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme (SVEP)
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Rural non-farm enterprise
schemes.bestFor: Small rural manufacturing, service and trading enterprise by SHG household
schemes.eligible: SHG woman/member or family in an approved SVEP block, subject to enterprise appraisal
schemes.benefit: Business planning, training, mentoring and access to community enterprise funds and bank credit through a Block Resource Centre. A budget of about ₹6.5 crore is earmarked per block; the loan/support amount for any one enterprise is block-plan specific.
schemes.access: Contact the Block Mission Management Unit/Community Resource Person – Enterprise Promotion in an approved SVEP block.
schemes.caution: Available only in approved blocks and through NRLM institutions; it is not a universal startup grant.

schemes.name: Watershed Development Component – PMKSY 2.0
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Watershed / agriculture
schemes.bestFor: Soil and water conservation, springshed, land development and livelihood activities in approved micro-watersheds
schemes.eligible: Households, user groups, SHGs and common lands in selected project areas
schemes.benefit: Support follows the sanctioned watershed DPR and community institutions; no single statewide individual percentage.
schemes.access: Ask the Rural Development/Watershed office whether the village is inside an approved WDC-PMKSY 2.0 project.
schemes.caution: Not open statewide; asset ownership, maintenance and livelihood-fund rules depend on the local DPR.

schemes.name: HPIIP 2019 – MSME land, shed, stamp duty and CLU incentives
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Manufacturing, eligible services and industrial infrastructure
schemes.bestFor: Units whose commercial production began by 31 December 2025
schemes.eligible: Eligible new MSME or expansion covered by the policy
schemes.benefit: Land/shed allotment at 50%/40%/30% of notified rate in A/B/C areas; stamp duty and registration charged at 50%/30%/10% of applicable rate; CLU exemption in B/C areas.
schemes.margin: Policy conditions and implementation schedule apply
schemes.access: Claim through Industries Department / Single Window with eligibility certificate
schemes.caution: The amended policy limits incentives to qualifying units commencing commercial production on or before 31-12-2025. No official extension was found as of the verification date; do not model this as a fresh-project incentive.

schemes.name: HPIIP 2019 – interest and plant-transport support
schemes.family: Credit guarantee working capital and equity
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Eligible MSME manufacturing and service units
schemes.bestFor: Qualifying policy-period units with term loans and machinery movement
schemes.eligible: Eligible MSME covered by HPIIP
schemes.benefit: Interest subvention 3% for 3 years, annual cap ₹2 lakh/₹4 lakh/₹6 lakh in A/B/C areas; 50% plant and machinery inland carriage/transit insurance capped at ₹2 lakh in A and ₹3 lakh in B/C.
schemes.access: Claim through District Industries Centre / Industries Department
schemes.caution: Only policy-period beneficiaries; verify sanction, location category and claim deadlines.

schemes.name: HPIIP 2019 – transport subsidy for B and C areas
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Eligible units in B and C industrial areas
schemes.bestFor: Policy-period units dispatching finished goods
schemes.eligible: Eligible enterprise covered by HPIIP
schemes.benefit: B area: actual within-state freight or 3% turnover, lower, up to ₹10 lakh/year for 3 years. C area: actual or 5%, lower, up to ₹10 lakh/year for 5 years.
schemes.access: Claim through Industries Department
schemes.caution: Fresh eligibility window ended 31-12-2025; turnover and freight definitions require official assessment.

schemes.name: HPIIP 2019 – net SGST reimbursement
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: MSME manufacturing
schemes.bestFor: Qualifying policy-period MSMEs paying net SGST
schemes.eligible: Eligible MSME covered by HPIIP
schemes.benefit: Non-steel MSMEs: 60% in A and 90% in B/C for 7 years, subject to 100% of fixed capital investment. Steel MSMEs: 50%/80%/90% in A/B/C for 7 years, capped at 80% of fixed capital investment.
schemes.access: Claim through Industries and State Taxes departments
schemes.agency: Department of Industries / State Taxes and Excise
schemes.caution: December 2023 amendment applies; fresh policy eligibility closed after 31-12-2025.

schemes.name: HPIIP 2019 – technology, quality, EHS and green-fuel support
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Eligible MSMEs
schemes.bestFor: Policy-period units upgrading quality, testing, pollution control or fuel
schemes.eligible: Eligible MSME covered by HPIIP
schemes.benefit: 50% of technology, certification and testing cost up to ₹5 lakh; ETP/rainwater machinery 25% up to ₹2 lakh; ETP electricity tariff 50% up to ₹1 lakh/year for 3 years; green-fuel conversion 50% up to ₹3 lakh.
schemes.access: Claim through Industries Department with technical approvals
schemes.caution: Fresh eligibility closed; separate environmental approvals remain mandatory.

schemes.name: HPIIP 2019 – employment, export, patent and SME listing support
schemes.status: Active - annual target or departmental sanction
schemes.label: Eligible industrial enterprises and MSMEs
schemes.bestFor: Policy-period units hiring Himachalis, exporting, patenting or listing
schemes.eligible: Eligible enterprise covered by HPIIP

schemes.caution: Vehicle category, attachment availability, eligibility, permit and bank conditions control sanction.

schemes.name: Rajiv Gandhi Swarozgar Start-up Yojana Phase-IV - passenger bus (electric and diesel)

schemes.label: Passenger transport

schemes.benefit: Phase-IV (announced 29 June 2026): 50% capital subsidy on electric buses and 30% on diesel buses with a minimum seating capacity of 32 passengers, plus a monthly operational incentive for 5 years of ₹65,000 for an e-bus and ₹50,000 for a diesel bus. About 1,000 routes with at least 10 per sub-division.
schemes.margin: Applicant finances balance; route and permit conditions apply
schemes.access: Apply against Transport Department notification and target
schemes.agency: Department of Labour, Employment and Overseas Placement with the Transport Department and District Administration

schemes.name: Mukhya Mantri Laghu Dukandar Kalyan Yojana (rural and 'Shahri' urban variant)
schemes.parent: Rajiv Gandhi Laghu Dukandar Sukh Kalyan Yojana

schemes.label: Small retail and local services
schemes.bestFor: Small shopkeepers needing debt relief or small credit

Credit: collateral-free business loan of up to ₹50,000 with a 50% interest subsidy for small shopkeepers and skilled workers (cobblers, tailors, barbers, phone-repair and produce vendors), as launched for rural areas in 2023. One-Time Settlement: assistance of up to ₹1 lakh to settle a business loan of up to ₹10 lakh that became an NPA between 1 April 2020 and 31 March 2025, extended to all Urban Local Bodies in December 2025.
schemes.access: Confirm current intake with District Industries Centre / lender
schemes.agency: Urban Development Department (urban local bodies) / Rural Development Department, with the lending bank and Nodal Bank
schemes.caution: The policy is reported in the Economic Survey, but a current public application window and complete operative guidelines were not located.

schemes.caution: This is not a general grant to open a coaching centre; accreditation, target allocation and outcomes control payments.

legacy.name: Stand-Up India
legacy.position: Original scheme period ended 31 March 2025; a revamped scheme was announced but not yet notified as of the verification date
legacy.why: The scheme's notified period ran to 31 March 2025 and lapsed. On 16 March 2026 the Finance Minister stated in the Lok Sabha that a revamped Stand-Up India for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs was being drafted; the original ₹10 lakh-₹1 crore bank-loan structure is expected to carry forward but the revamped scheme had not been notified as of verification.
legacy.alt: Use PMEGP, MMSY, PMMY, CGTMSE/SCLCSS or targeted corporation finance as applicable.

legacy.name: HP Industrial Investment Policy 2019 incentives
legacy.position: Extended - the 2019 policy has been kept alive past its 31 December 2025 cutoff pending a new industrial policy
legacy.why: The policy lapsed on 31 December 2025 but the State has extended it repeatedly while the successor industrial policy remains unnotified - most recently, as reported on 18 August 2026, up to 12 October 2026. It is therefore still available to units commencing commercial production within the extended window, but the end date moves and must be checked before committing investment.
legacy.alt: Confirm the live end date with the Single Window Clearance Authority / Department of Industries before committing investment, and in parallel examine MMSY, Startup Himachal, State Mission on Food Processing and central schemes.

legacy.name: General CLCSS
legacy.position: Superseded/closed as a general current scheme
legacy.why: Do not use old 15%/₹15 lakh CLCSS data as a current general entitlement.
legacy.alt: SC/ST-owned MSEs should examine current SCLCSS; all MSEs can examine ZED, LEAN, GIFT, SPICE and other technology schemes.

legacy.name: SIDBI ARISE
legacy.why: SIDBI reports ARISE, SPEED Plus and PRATHAM branch products were merged into SPEED.
legacy.alt: Ask SIDBI for current SPEED/equipment-finance terms.

legacy.name: Gramin Bhandaran Yojana
legacy.why: The old Rural Godown/Gramin Bhandaran branding should not be treated as a live standalone scheme.
legacy.alt: Check AMI/AIF/NHB/MIDH; verify a live post-31 March 2026 AMI sanction window.

legacy.name: Dairy Infrastructure Development Fund (DIDF)
legacy.why: Do not prepare a fresh DIDF application.
legacy.alt: Check AHIDF, but confirm a fresh post-31 March 2026 window.

legacy.name: National Scheme of Welfare of Fishermen
legacy.why: Insurance, saving-cum-relief and related welfare now operate through PMMSY/State implementation.
legacy.alt: Use PMMSY/PM-MKSSY and HP Fisheries Department current enrolments.

legacy.name: NABARD RIDF
legacy.why: RIDF finances State/public rural infrastructure; an individual MSME/farm unit does not apply as a beneficiary enterprise.
legacy.alt: Use AIF, NCDC or the relevant direct beneficiary scheme.

legacy.name: VCF-SC
legacy.position: Indirect fund/equity route; original row not a direct subsidy
legacy.why: Fund availability and investee selection are manager-led and should not be represented as a fixed beneficiary grant.
legacy.alt: Check NSFDC/PM-SURAJ and current fund manager/Startup India equity routes.

legacy.name: AHIDF
legacy.position: Fresh applications after 31 March 2026 not confirmed
legacy.why: Official page states scheme approval through 31 March 2026; legacy/committed cases may continue.
legacy.alt: Confirm new notification with DAHD and lender before relying on it.

legacy.name: FIDF
legacy.position: Fresh proposals after 31 March 2026 not confirmed
legacy.why: Official published extension ran through 31 March 2026.
legacy.alt: Check FIDF portal/Department of Fisheries for a new extension.

legacy.name: PMFME
legacy.why: Benefit architecture remains relevant for approved/legacy cases, but original programme period was through FY2025-26.
legacy.alt: Check the HP nodal agency and portal for a live intake.

legacy.name: PRIP – Promotion of Research and Innovation in Pharma-MedTech
legacy.position: Round 1 closed; no further round presently planned
legacy.why: The portal closed on 19 November 2025. The Department subsequently stated that, because the scheme closes in March 2027 and needs a one-year gestation period, no further application rounds are under consideration.
legacy.alt: For a new innovation examine BIRAC BIG, MSME Innovative, iDEX/TDF where relevant, Startup Himachal, or future successor notifications.

legacy.name: PLI Scheme for Pharmaceuticals
legacy.why: The scheme is paying incentive to selected applicants; no general fresh application window was located for a new unit in August 2026.
legacy.alt: New pharma units should examine RPTUAS if an upgrade window reopens, the Haroli Bulk Drug Park, general MSME finance, and future DoP calls.

legacy.name: PLI Scheme for Medical Devices
legacy.why: Current releases report implementation/disbursement but no fresh general application window.
legacy.alt: Examine SMDI MIS-RID, clinical-study support, cluster facilities and future DoP notices.

legacy.name: PLI Scheme for Bulk Drugs
legacy.position: Current invitation closed / approved projects continue
legacy.why: The most recent located invitation was dated 19 February 2026 for specified eligible products; no open August 2026 window was located. Incentive continues for approved applicants through the scheme period.
legacy.alt: Monitor the Department of Pharmaceuticals scheme page for another product-specific invitation and consider the Haroli Bulk Drug Park.

legacy.name: Himachal Pradesh Medical Device Park, Nalagarh
legacy.position: Infrastructure under development; some works on hold
legacy.why: HP Economic Survey 2025-26 states operation/management activity is under implementation but certain civil works are on hold due to shortage of funds. It is an industrial-location project, not a universal cash scheme.
legacy.alt: Ask HP Industries/implementing corporation for the current plot-allotment notice and written concessions before relying on the park.

legacy.name: ₹10,000 crore SME Growth Fund
legacy.position: Announced in Union Budget 2026-27; operational criteria not yet located
legacy.why: A budget announcement is not an investible scheme until the fund structure, manager, eligibility and application route are notified.
legacy.alt: Use the active SRI Fund/Daughter Fund route or ordinary equity/debt meanwhile; monitor MSME Ministry notifications.

legacy.name: Revamped Pharmaceutical Technology Upgradation Assistance Scheme (RPTUAS)
legacy.why: As of 4 August 2026, a temporary restriction remained while extension was considered; 21 HP applications were pending. Drug licences, Schedule M/WHO-GMP certification and two-stage verification apply.
legacy.alt: Monitor the Department of Pharmaceuticals SPI page/portal and obtain confirmation that fresh intake has reopened before committing upgrade expenditure.

legacy.name: Assistance to Pharmaceutical Industry for Common Facilities (API-CF)
legacy.why: Latest located fresh window closed in January 2025; the 4 August 2026 official update reported no HP proposal pending under API-CF. Not an individual-unit grant.
legacy.alt: Form/strengthen the SPV and monitor the SPI scheme page for a fresh API-CF application window before preparing the final DPR.

legacy.name: SMDI – Marginal Investment Scheme for Reducing Import Dependence (MIS-RID)
legacy.why: The June/July 2026 call closed on 24 July 2026. Incentive follows commissioning and verification; land is excluded and device/product eligibility is narrow.
legacy.alt: Use the SMDI portal only against a live notice and obtain product/category confirmation before investment.

legacy.name: SMDI – Medical Device Clinical Studies Support
legacy.why: The July 2026 call is closed. Funding does not replace regulatory approval and is reimbursed only for admissible Indian studies and verified milestones.
legacy.alt: Secure CDSCO/ethics and other required permissions, then apply through SMDI only during a live call.

legacy.name: SMDI – Common Facilities for Medical Device Clusters
legacy.why: The July 2026 proposal window has closed. It is not a grant to one factory and requires shared-access governance and sustainable operations.
legacy.alt: Prepare a cluster DPR and apply through SMDI only under a live call.

legacy.name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF)
legacy.why: Official approval was stated through 31 March 2026; as of verification, a fresh post-March-2026 sanction window was not confirmed.
legacy.alt: Check portal/DAHD notice and lender before preparing a fresh application.

legacy.name: Fisheries and Aquaculture Infrastructure Development Fund (FIDF)
legacy.why: Published extension ran through 31 March 2026; fresh proposal status after that date was not confirmed.
legacy.alt: Check current FIDF portal/Department of Fisheries before a fresh proposal.

legacy.name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
legacy.why: Original implementation period was through FY2025-26; portal/legacy processing continues, but a fresh FY2026-27 intake was not confirmed in the source reviewed.
legacy.alt: Check HP PMFME/DIC and portal for a currently open intake.

legacy.name: HPIIP 2019 – MSME land, shed, stamp duty and CLU incentives
legacy.why: The amended policy limits incentives to qualifying units commencing commercial production on or before 31-12-2025. No official extension was found as of the verification date; do not model this as a fresh-project incentive.
legacy.alt: Claim through Industries Department / Single Window with eligibility certificate

legacy.name: HPIIP 2019 – interest and plant-transport support

legacy.alt: Claim through District Industries Centre / Industries Department

legacy.name: HPIIP 2019 – transport subsidy for B and C areas

legacy.alt: Claim through Industries Department

legacy.name: HPIIP 2019 – net SGST reimbursement
legacy.why: December 2023 amendment applies; fresh policy eligibility closed after 31-12-2025.
legacy.alt: Claim through Industries and State Taxes departments

legacy.name: HPIIP 2019 – technology, quality, EHS and green-fuel support
legacy.why: Fresh eligibility closed; separate environmental approvals remain mandatory.
legacy.alt: Claim through Industries Department with technical approvals

legacy.name: HPIIP 2019 – employment, export, patent and SME listing support

legacy.alt: Claim through Industries Department
